verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
व्याख्याता भवता सर्ग-वंश-मन्वन्तरस्थितः ।
वंशानुचरितञ्चवै विस्तरेण महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
vyakhyata bhavata sarga-vamsha-manvantarasthitah |
vamshanucharitanchavai vistarena mahamune ||

verses.sa:
श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं त्वत्तो यथावदूपसंह्टतिम् ।
महाप्रलयसंस्थानं कल्पान्ते च महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
shrotumichchhamyaham tvatto yathavadupasamhtatim |
mahapralayasamsthanam kalpante cha mahamune ||

verses.sa:
पराशा उवाच ।
मैत्रेय श्रुयतां मत्तो यथावदुपसंह्टतिः ।
कल्पान्ते प्राकृते चैव प्रलयो जायते यथा ॥
verses.rom:
parasha uvacha |
maitreya shruyatam matto yathavadupasamhtatih |
kalpante prakrite chaiva pralayo jayate yatha ||

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रं पितणान्तु मासोऽब्दस्त्रिदिवौकसाम
चतुर्युगसहस्त्र तु ब्रह्मणो द्रे द्रिजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
ahoratram pitanantu maso'bdastridivaukasama
chaturyugasahastra tu brahmano dre drijottama ||

verses.sa:
कृतं त्रेता द्रापरश्व कलिश्चैव चतुर्युगम् ।
दिव्यैर्वर्षसहस्त्रैस्तु तदू द्रादशभिरुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
kritam treta draparashva kalishchaiva chaturyugam |
divyairvarshasahastraistu tadu dradashabhiruchyate ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्युगाण्यशेषाणि सदृशानि स्वरूपतः ।
आद्य कृतयुगं मुक्त्वा मैत्रेयान्ते तथा कलिम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaturyuganyasheshani sadrishani svarupatah |
adya kritayugam muktva maitreyante tatha kalim ||

verses.sa:
आद्ये कृतयुगो सर्गा ब्रह्मणा क्रियते यतः
क्रियते चोपसंहारस्तथान्ते च कलौ युगे ॥
verses.rom:
adye kritayugo sarga brahmana kriyate yatah
kriyate chopasamharastathante cha kalau yuge ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
कलेः स्वरूपं भगवन् विस्तरादू वक्तुमर्हसि ।
धर्म्मश्वतुष्पाद्भगवन यस्मिन विप्लवमृच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
kaleh svarupam bhagavan vistaradu vaktumarhasi |
dharmmashvatushpadbhagavana yasmina viplavamrichchhati ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
कलेः खरूपं मैत्रेय यद्भवान् प्रष्टुमिच्छति ।
तन्निबोध समासन्नं वर्त्तते यन्महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
kaleh kharupam maitreya yadbhavan prashtumichchhati |
tannibodha samasannam varttate yanmahamune ||

verses.sa:
वर्णाश्रमाचारवती प्रवृत्तिर्न कलौ नृणाम् ।
नसाम-ऋगू-यजुर्व्वेदविनिष्पादनहेतुका ॥
verses.rom:
varnashramacharavati pravrittirna kalau nrinam |
nasama-rigu-yajurvvedavinishpadanahetuka ||

verses.sa:
विवाहा न कलौ धर्म्म्या न शिष्य-गुरुसंस्थितिः ।
नि दाम्पत्यक्रमो नैव वह्निदैवात्मकः क्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
vivaha na kalau dharmmya na shishya-gurusamsthitih |
ni dampatyakramo naiva vahnidaivatmakah kramah ||

verses.sa:
यत्र तत्र कुले जातो बली सर्व्वेस्वरः कलौ ।
सर्व्वेभ्य एव वर्णेभ्यो योग्यः कन्यावरोधने ॥
verses.rom:
yatra tatra kule jato bali sarvvesvarah kalau |
sarvvebhya eva varnebhyo yogyah kanyavarodhane ||

verses.sa:
येन कैनैव योगेन द्रिजातिर्दीक्षितः कलौ ।
यौव सैव च मैत्रेय प्रायश्वित्तक्रिया कलौ ॥
verses.rom:
yena kainaiva yogena drijatirdikshitah kalau |
yauva saiva cha maitreya prayashvittakriya kalau ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वमेव कलौ शास्त्रं यस्य यदूवचनं द्रिज ।
देवाताश्व कलौ सर्व्वाः सर्व्वः सर्व्वस्य चाश्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvameva kalau shastram yasya yaduvachanam drija |
devatashva kalau sarvvah sarvvah sarvvasya chashramah ||

verses.sa:
उपवासस्तथायासो वित्तोतूसर्गस्तथा कलौ ।
धर्म्मो यथाभिरुचितैरनुष्ठानैरनुष्ठितः ॥
verses.rom:
upavasastathayaso vittotusargastatha kalau |
dharmmo yathabhiruchitairanushthanairanushthitah ||

verses.sa:
वित्तेन भविता पुंसां स्वल्पेनाढ्यमदः कलौ ।
स्त्रीणां रूपमदश्चैव केशैरेव भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vittena bhavita pumsam svalpenadhyamadah kalau |
strinam rupamadashchaiva keshaireva bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
सुवर्णमणिरत्रादौ वस्त्रे चापि क्षयं गते ।
कलौ स्त्रियो भविष्यन्ति तदा केशैरलङ्कृताः ॥
verses.rom:
suvarnamaniratradau vastre chapi kshayam gate |
kalau striyo bhavishyanti tada keshairalankritah ||

verses.sa:
परित्यक्षन्ति भर्त्तारं वित्तहीनं तथा स्त्रियः ।
भर्त्ता भविष्यति कलौ वित्तवानेव योषिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
parityakshanti bharttaram vittahinam tatha striyah |
bhartta bhavishyati kalau vittavaneva yoshitam ||

verses.sa:
योयो ददाति बहुल सस स्वामी तदा नृणाम् ।
स्वामित्वहेतुः सम्बन्ध भावी नाभिजनस्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
yoyo dadati bahula sasa svami tada nrinam |
svamitvahetuh sambandha bhavi nabhijanastada ||

verses.sa:
गृहान्ता द्रव्यसङ्घाता द्रव्यान्ता च तथा मतिः ।
अर्थाश्वात्मोपभोगान्ता भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ॥
verses.rom:
grihanta dravyasanghata dravyanta cha tatha matih |
arthashvatmopabhoganta bhavishyanti kalau yuge ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रियः कलौ भविष्यन्ति स्वैरिणयो ललितस्पृहाः ।
अन्यायावाप्तवित्तेषु पुरुषाश्व स्पृहालवः ॥
verses.rom:
striyah kalau bhavishyanti svairinayo lalitasprihah |
anyayavaptavitteshu purushashva sprihalavah ||

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्थितोऽपि सुह्टदा स्वार्थहानिं न मानवः ।
पणार्द्धार्द्धार्द्धमात्रेऽपि करिष्यति तदा द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarthito'pi suhtada svarthahanim na manavah |
panarddharddharddhamatre'pi karishyati tada drija ||

verses.sa:
समानं पौरुषञ्चतो भावि विप्र षु वै कलौ ।
क्षीरप्रदानसम्बन्धि भावि गोषु च गौरवम् ॥
verses.rom:
samanam paurushanchato bhavi vipra shu vai kalau |
kshirapradanasambandhi bhavi goshu cha gauravam ||

verses.sa:
अनावृष्टिभियप्रायाः प्रजाः क्षुद्भयकातराः ।
भविष्यन्ति तदा सर्व्वा गगनासक्तदृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
anavrishtibhiyaprayah prajah kshudbhayakatarah |
bhavishyanti tada sarvva gaganasaktadrishtayah ||

verses.sa:
कन्दपर्णफलाहारास्तापसा इव मानवाः ।
आत्मानं पातयिष्यन्ति तदा वृष्ट्यादिदुः खिताः ॥
verses.rom:
kandaparnaphalaharastapasa iva manavah |
atmanam patayishyanti tada vrishtyadiduh khitah ||

verses.sa:
दुर्भिक्षमेव सततं तदा क्ले शमनीश्वराः ।
प्रापूस्यन्ति व्याहतसुखप्रमोदा मानवाः कलौ ॥
verses.rom:
durbhikshameva satatam tada kle shamanishvarah |
prapusyanti vyahatasukhapramoda manavah kalau ||

verses.sa:
अस्त्रानबोजिनो नाग्रिदेवतातिथिपूजनूम् ।
करिष्यन्ति कलौ प्राप्ते न च पिव्योदकक्रियाम् ॥
verses.rom:
astranabojino nagridevatatithipujanum |
karishyanti kalau prapte na cha pivyodakakriyam ||

verses.sa:
लोलुपा ह्रस्वदेहाश्व वह्वन्नादनतत्पराः ।
बहुप्रजाल्पभाग्याश्व भविष्यन्ति कलौ स्त्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
lolupa hrasvadehashva vahvannadanatatparah |
bahuprajalpabhagyashva bhavishyanti kalau striyah ||

verses.sa:
उभाभ्यामेव पाणिभ्यां शिरः कण्डूयनं स्त्रियः ।
कुर्व्वन्त्यो गुरुभर्त्तृणामाज्ञां भेतूस्यन्त्यनादृताः ॥
verses.rom:
ubhabhyameva panibhyam shirah kanduyanam striyah |
kurvvantyo gurubharttrinamajnam bhetusyantyanadritah ||

verses.sa:
स्वपोषणपराः क्षुद्रा देहसंस्कारवर्ज्जिताः ।
परुषानृतभाषिण्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ स्त्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
svaposhanaparah kshudra dehasamskaravarjjitah |
parushanritabhashinyo bhavishyanti kalau striyah ||

verses.sa:
दुः शीला दुष्टशीलेषु कुर्व्वन्त्यः सततं स्पृहाम् ।
असदूवुत्ता भविष्यन्ति पुरुषेषु कुलाङ्गनाः ॥
verses.rom:
duh shila dushtashileshu kurvvantyah satatam spriham |
asaduvutta bhavishyanti purusheshu kulanganah ||

verses.sa:
वेदादानं करिष्यन्ति वटवश्व तदाव्रताः ।
गुहस्थाश्व न होष्यन्ति न दास्यन्त्युचितान्यपि ॥
verses.rom:
vedadanam karishyanti vatavashva tadavratah |
guhasthashva na hoshyanti na dasyantyuchitanyapi ||

verses.sa:
वनावासा भविष्यन्ति ग्राम्याहारपरिग्रहाः ।
भिक्षवश्वापि मित्रादिस्नेहसम्बन्धयन्त्रिताः ॥
verses.rom:
vanavasa bhavishyanti gramyaharaparigrahah |
bhikshavashvapi mitradisnehasambandhayantritah ||

verses.sa:
अरक्षितारो हर्त्तारः शुल्कव्याजेन पार्थिवाः ।
हारिणो जनवित्तानां संप्राप्ते तु कलो युगे ॥
verses.rom:
arakshitaro harttarah shulkavyajena parthivah |
harino janavittanam samprapte tu kalo yuge ||

verses.sa:
यो योऽश्वरथनागाढ्यः स स राजा भविष्यति ।
यश्व यश्वाबलः सर्व्वः स स भृत्यः कलौ युगे ॥
verses.rom:
yo yo'shvarathanagadhyah sa sa raja bhavishyati |
yashva yashvabalah sarvvah sa sa bhrityah kalau yuge ||

verses.sa:
वैश्याः कृषिवाणिज्यादि सन्त्यज्य निजकर्म्म यत्
शूद्रवृत्त्या प्रवत्स्यन्ति कारुकर्म्मोपजीविनः ॥
verses.rom:
vaishyah krishivanijyadi santyajya nijakarmma yat
shudravrittya pravatsyanti karukarmmopajivinah ||

verses.sa:
भैक्ष्यव्रतास्तथा शूद्रा प्रब्रज्यालिङ्गिनोऽधमाः ।
पाषण्डसंश्रयाः वृत्तिमाश्रयिष्यन्त्यसंस्कृताः ॥
verses.rom:
bhaikshyavratastatha shudra prabrajyalingino'dhamah |
pashandasamshrayah vrittimashrayishyantyasamskritah ||

verses.sa:
दुर्भिक्षकरपीड़ाबिरतीवोपहता जनाः ।
गवेधुककदन्नाद्यान् देशान् यास्यन्ति दुः खिताः ॥
verses.rom:
durbhikshakarapirabirativopahata janah |
gavedhukakadannadyan deshan yasyanti duh khitah ||

verses.sa:
वेदमार्गे प्रलीने च पाषण्डाढये ततो जने ।
अधर्म्मवृद्धया लोकानां स्वल्पमायुर्भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vedamarge praline cha pashandadhaye tato jane |
adharmmavriddhaya lokanam svalpamayurbhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
अशास्त्रविहित्तं घोरं तप्यमानेषु वै तपः ।
नरेषु नृपदोषेण बालमृत्युर्भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
ashastravihittam ghoram tapyamaneshu vai tapah |
nareshu nripadoshena balamrityurbhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
भवित्री योषितां सूतिः पञ्चषटूसप्तवार्षिकी ।
नवाष्टदशवर्षाणां मनुष्याणां तथा कलौ ॥
verses.rom:
bhavitri yoshitam sutih panchashatusaptavarshiki |
navashtadashavarshanam manushyanam tatha kalau ||

verses.sa:
पतितोद्भवश्व भविता तदा द्रादशवार्षिकः ।
नातिजीवति वै कश्वित् कलौ वर्षाणि विंशतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
patitodbhavashva bhavita tada dradashavarshikah |
natijivati vai kashvit kalau varshani vimshatim ||

verses.sa:
अल्पप्रज्ञा वृथालिङ्गा दुष्टान्तः करणाः कलौ ।
यतस्ततो विनङूक्ष्यन्ति कालेनाल्पेन मानवाः ॥
verses.rom:
alpaprajna vrithalinga dushtantah karanah kalau |
yatastato vinanukshyanti kalenalpena manavah ||

verses.sa:
यदा यदा हि पाषणडवृद्धिर्मैत्रेय लक्ष्यते ।
तदा तदा कलेर्वृद्धिरनुमेया विचक्षणौः ॥
verses.rom:
yada yada hi pashanadavriddhirmaitreya lakshyate |
tada tada kalervriddhiranumeya vichakshanauh ||

verses.sa:
यदा यदा सतां हानिर्वेदमार्गानुसारिणाम् ।
प्रारम्भाश्वावसीदन्ति यदा धर्म्मभृतां नृणाम् ।
तदानुमेयं प्राधान्यं कलेर्मैत्रेय पणिडतैः ॥
verses.rom:
yada yada satam hanirvedamarganusarinam |
prarambhashvavasidanti yada dharmmabhritam nrinam |
tadanumeyam pradhanyam kalermaitreya panidataih ||

verses.sa:
यदा यदा न यज्ञानामीश्वरः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
इज्यते पुरुषैर्यज्ञैस्तदा ज्ञे यं कलेर्बलम् ॥
verses.rom:
yada yada na yajnanamishvarah purushottamah |
ijyate purushairyajnaistada jne yam kalerbalam ||

verses.sa:
न प्रीतिर्वेदवादेषु पाषणडेषु यदा रतिः ।
कलेर्वृद्धिस्तदा प्राज्ञरैनुमेया विचक्षणैः ॥
verses.rom:
na pritirvedavadeshu pashanadeshu yada ratih |
kalervriddhistada prajnarainumeya vichakshanaih ||

verses.sa:
कलौ जगत्पतिं विष्णुं सर्व्वस्त्रष्टारमीश्वरम् ।
नार्च्चयिष्यन्ति मैत्रेय पाषणडोपहता नराः ॥
verses.rom:
kalau jagatpatim vishnum sarvvastrashtaramishvaram |
narchchayishyanti maitreya pashanadopahata narah ||

verses.sa:
कि वेदैः किं द्रिजैर्देवैः किं शौचेनाम्बुजन्मना ।
इत्येवं विप्र वक्ष्यन्ति पाषण्डोपहता नराः ॥
verses.rom:
ki vedaih kim drijairdevaih kim shauchenambujanmana |
ityevam vipra vakshyanti pashandopahata narah ||

verses.sa:
स्वल्पाम्बुवृष्टिः पर्ज्जन्यः शस्यं स्वल्पफल तथा
फलं तथाल्पसारञ्च विप्र प्रापते कलौ युगे ॥
verses.rom:
svalpambuvrishtih parjjanyah shasyam svalpaphala tatha
phalam tathalpasarancha vipra prapate kalau yuge ||

verses.sa:
शाणीप्रायाणि वस्त्राणि शमीप्राया महीरुहाः ।
शूद्रप्रायास्तथा वर्णा भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ॥
verses.rom:
shaniprayani vastrani shamipraya mahiruhah |
shudraprayastatha varna bhavishyanti kalau yuge ||

verses.sa:
अणुप्रायाणि धान्यानि अजाप्रायं तथा पयः ।
भविष्यति कलौ प्राप्ते उषोरञ्चानुलेपनम् ॥
verses.rom:
anuprayani dhanyani ajaprayam tatha payah |
bhavishyati kalau prapte ushoranchanulepanam ||

verses.sa:
शश्रू-श्वशुरभूयिष्ठा गुरवश्व नृणां कलौ ।
श्यालाद्या हारिभाय्योश्व सुह्टदो मुनिसतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shashru-shvashurabhuyishtha guravashva nrinam kalau |
shyaladya haribhayyoshva suhtado munisatam ||

verses.sa:
कस्य माता पिता कस्य यदा कर्म्मानुगः पुमान् ।
इति चोदाहरिष्यन्ति श्वशुरानुगेता नराः ॥
verses.rom:
kasya mata pita kasya yada karmmanugah puman |
iti chodaharishyanti shvashuranugeta narah ||

verses.sa:
वाङूमनः कायिकैर्दोषैरभिभूताः पुनः पुनः ।
नराः पापान्यनुदिनं करिष्यन्त्यल्पमेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
vanumanah kayikairdoshairabhibhutah punah punah |
narah papanyanudinam karishyantyalpamedhasah ||

verses.sa:
निः सत्त्वानामशौचानां निः श्रीकाणां तथा नृणाम् ।
यदूयदू दुः शाय यत् सर्व्वं कलिकाले भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
nih sattvanamashauchanam nih shrikanam tatha nrinam |
yaduyadu duh shaya yat sarvvam kalikale bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
निःस्वाध्यायवषटूकरि स्वधास्वाहाविवर्ज्जिते ।
तथा प्रविरलो विप्र क्वचिल्लोको निवत्स्यति ॥
verses.rom:
nihsvadhyayavashatukari svadhasvahavivarjjite |
tatha praviralo vipra kvachilloko nivatsyati ||

verses.sa:
तत्राल्पेनैव यत्नेन पुण्यस्कन्धमनुत्तमम् ।
करोति यं कृतयुगे क्रियते तपसा हि सः ॥
verses.rom:
tatralpenaiva yatnena punyaskandhamanuttamam |
karoti yam kritayuge kriyate tapasa hi sah ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—"Thou hast described unto me in detail, O illustrious sage, the creation of the universe, the genealogies of the Patriarchs, the duration of the Manwantaras and the dynasties of the princes. I am willing to hear from you an account of the dissolution of the universe, the time of total destruction and that which occurs at the expiration of a Kalpa".

Parāçara said:—Hear from me exactly, O Maitreya, the circumstances attending the dissolution of the world either at the expiration of a Kalpa or that which occurs at the close of the life of Brahmā. A month of men constitutes a day and night of the progenitors; a year of men is a day and night of the celestials. Twice a thousand aggregates of the four ages is a day and night of Brahmhā. The four ages are the Krita, Treta, Dwāpara and Kali, comprehending altogether twelve thousand years of the celestials. There are infinite successions of those four ages of a similar description, the first of which is always called Krita and the last the Kali. In the first, the Krita is that age which is created by Brahmā; in the last, which is the Kali age, a dissolution of the universe takes place.

Maitreya said:—"O venerable Sir, It behoves thee to give a description of the nature of the Kali age in which the four-footed virtue suffers total extinction".

Parāçara said:—Hear, O Maitreya, of the nature of the Kali age, regarding which you have enquired and which is now approaching completion.

In the Kali age, people will not serve caste, order and institutes, nor the ceremonial enjoined by the Sāma, Rik and Yayur Vedas. Marriages in this age will be celebrated according to the rituals, nor will the rules that connect the spiritual protector and his disciple be in force; the laws that regulate the conduct of husband and wife will be neglected and oblations to the celestials with fire no longer be offered. A powerful and rich man, in whatever family he may be born, will have right to marry maidens of every tribe. In the Kali age, a Brāhmana will be always regarded as such even if he be not initiated properly, and many forms of penance will be prescribed. O Maitreya, O twice-born one, all texts will be considered as Sastras in the Kali age; all celestials will be considered in equal light and all orders of life will be common alike to all persons. In this Kali age, fasting, austerity, liberality practised according to the pleasures of those by whom they are observed will constitute piety. Every trifling property will make men proud of their wealth. Pride of beauty will be inspired by hair. Gold, jewels, diamonds, clothes will all have perished, and then hair will be the only ornament with which women can decorate themselves. Wives will desert their husbands when they will lose their wealth; and the rich only will be considered by woman as their lords. He who will distribute immense wealth, will be considered as master of men and prestige of birth will no longer be a title to supremacy. Accumulated wealth will be spent on ostentatious dwellings. The minds of men will be wholly occupied with earning money and that even will be spent on the gratification of selfish desires. Women will follow their own inclinations and be given up to pleasure-seeking. Men will endeavour to acquire riches even dishonestly. No man will part with the smallest fraction of his wealth at the sacrifice of his own interest even when requested by his friends. In the Kali age all people will consider themselves as equal with the Brāhmanas; and cows will be held in reverence only because they supply milk. People will be always in fear of dearth and scarcity and will watch accordingly the appearances of the sky. They will all live, like anchorets, upon leaves and roots and fruits and put a period to their lives through fear of famine and want. Deprived of wealth, people will be perpetually subject to famine and other afflictions; and they will never enjoy pleasure and happiness. At the advent of the Kali they will take their food without previous ablutions and without worshipping fire, celestials or guests or offering obsequial libations to their progenitors. The women will be fickle, short of stature, gluttonous; they will all have many children and little means. And scratching their heads with both hands they will pay no attention to the commands of their husbands or parents. They will be selfish, abject and slovenly; they will be scolds and liars; they will be indecent and immoral in their conduct and will ever attach themselves to dissolute men. And disregarding the rules of studentship youths will study the Vedas. Householders will neither sacrifice nor practise becoming liberality. Anchorets will live upon food accepted from rustics and mendicants will be influenced by regard for friends and associates. Princes will plunder their subjects instead of protecting them and under the pretext of levying customs they will rob merchants of their property. In the Kali Vuga every one, possessing cars and elephants and horses, will be a Raja; every one who is feeble will be a slave. Vaiçyas will abandon agriculture and commerce and gain a livelihood by servitude or exercise of mechanical arts; Sudras, seeking a subsistence by begging and assuming outward marks of religious mendicants, will become the impure followers of impious and heretical doctrines.

Oppressed by famine and taxation men will desert their native countries and repair to the lands which are fit for coarser grains. The path of the Vedas being obliterated and people having deviated into heresy, iniquity will flourish and the duration of life will therefore decrease. On account of the horrible penances enjoined by scripture and of the vices of the rulers, children will die in their infancy. Women will bear children at the age of five, six or seven years and men will beget them when they are eight, nine or ten. Men will grow old at the age of twelve and no one will live more than twenty years. Men will possess little sense, vigour virtue and will therefore die in a short time. O Maitreya, the wise then estimate the approach of Kali when the number of heretics increases. Whenever, O Maitreya, number of the pious devoted to the lessons of the Vedas, diminishes, the efforts, of the individuals who cultivate virtue, become relax; the first of males becomes no longer the object of sacrifice; respect for the teachers of the Vedas declines and regard is cherished for the disseminators of heresy, the wise estimate the augmented influence of the Kali.

O Maitreya, in the Kali age corrupted by unbelievers, men will refrain from adoring Vishnu, the lord of sacrifice and the creator and sovereign of all and will say "Of what authority are the Vedas? What are the celestials or Brahmanas? What need there is of purification with water?" At the approach of the Kali, O Vipra, the clouds will yield scanty rain; the corn will be light in ear and the grain will be poor and of little sap: garments will be mostly made of the fibres of the San: the principal of trees will be the Sami; principle caste will be the Sudra; millet will be the more common grain; the milk in use will be chiefly that of goats; unguents will be made of Ushira grass. The mother and father-in-law will be venerated in the place of parents; and a man's friend will be his brother-in-law or one who has a wanton wife. Men will say "Who has a father? Who has a mother? Every one is born according to his deeds"; therefore they will regard the wife's or the husband's parents as their own. Gifted with little sense they will be subject to all sorts of infirmities of mind, speech and body and will daily commit sins; and every thing that is likely to afflict beings, vicious, impure and wretched will be generated in the Kali Yuga. Thus, O Brahman, when holy study, oblations to fire and convocations of the celestials shall be stopped some few people shall live at a holy place. And at this place with the least trouble that piety shall be accumulated which could be acquired with the greatest exertions in the Krita age.

verses.sa:
व्यासश्वाह महाबुद्धिर्यदत्रैव हि वस्तुनि ।
तच्छ्रूयतां महाभाग गदतो मम तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
vyasashvaha mahabuddhiryadatraiva hi vastuni |
tachchhruyatam mahabhaga gadato mama tattvatah ||

verses.sa:
कस्मिन् कालेऽल्पको धर्म्मो ददाति सुमहत् फलम् ।
मुनीनामित्यभूद् वादः कैश्वासौ क्रियते सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
kasmin kale'lpako dharmmo dadati sumahat phalam |
muninamityabhud vadah kaishvasau kriyate sukham ||

verses.sa:
सन्देहनिर्णयार्थाय वेदव्यासं महामुनिम् ।
ययुस्ते संशयं प्रष्टुं मैत्रेय मुनिपुङ्गवाः ॥
verses.rom:
sandehanirnayarthaya vedavyasam mahamunim |
yayuste samshayam prashtum maitreya munipungavah ||

verses.sa:
ददृशुस्ते मुनिं तत्र जाह्नवीसलिले द्रिजाः ।
वेदव्यासं महाभागमर्द्धस्त्रातं महामतिम ॥
verses.rom:
dadrishuste munim tatra jahnavisalile drijah |
vedavyasam mahabhagamarddhastratam mahamatima ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रानावसानं तत्तस्य प्रतीक्षन्तो महर्षय- ।
तस्थूस्तटे महानद्यास्तरुषण्डमुपाश्रिताः ॥
verses.rom:
stranavasanam tattasya pratikshanto maharshaya- |
tasthustate mahanadyastarushandamupashritah ||

verses.sa:
मग्रोऽथ जाह्नवीतोयादुत्थायाह सुतो मम ।
कलिः साधुः कलिः साधुरित्येवं श्वृण्वतां वचः ॥
verses.rom:
magro'tha jahnavitoyadutthayaha suto mama |
kalih sadhuh kalih sadhurityevam shvrinvatam vachah ||

verses.sa:
तेषां मुनीनां भूयश्व ममज्ज स नदीजले ।
उत्थाय साधु साघ्विति शूद्र धन्योऽसि चाब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
tesham muninam bhuyashva mamajja sa nadijale |
utthaya sadhu saghviti shudra dhanyo'si chabravit ||

verses.sa:
स निमग्रः समुत्थाय पुनः प्राह महामुनिः ।
योषितः साधुधन्यास्तास्ताभ्यो धन्यतरोऽस्ति कः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nimagrah samutthaya punah praha mahamunih |
yoshitah sadhudhanyastastabhyo dhanyataro'sti kah ||

verses.sa:
ततः स्त्रात्वा यथान्यायमायान्तं कृतसत्क्रियम् ।
उपतस्थुर्महाभागं मुनयस्ते सुतं मम ॥
verses.rom:
tatah stratva yathanyayamayantam kritasatkriyam |
upatasthurmahabhagam munayaste sutam mama ||

verses.sa:
कृतसंवन्दनांश्वाह कृतासनपरिग्रहान् ।
किमर्थमागता यूयमिति सत्यवतीसुतः ॥
verses.rom:
kritasamvandanamshvaha kritasanaparigrahan |
kimarthamagata yuyamiti satyavatisutah ||

verses.sa:
तमूचुः संशयं प्रष्टुं भवन्तं वयमागताः ।
अल तेनास्तु तावन्नः कथ्यतामपरं त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
tamuchuh samshayam prashtum bhavantam vayamagatah |
ala tenastu tavannah kathyatamaparam tvaya ||

verses.sa:
कलिः साघ्विति यत् प्रोक्तं शूद्रः साघ्विति योषितः ।
यदाह भगवान् साधु धन्याश्चेति पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
kalih saghviti yat proktam shudrah saghviti yoshitah |
yadaha bhagavan sadhu dhanyashcheti punah punah ||

verses.sa:
तत् सर्व्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामो न चेदू गुह्य महामुने ।
तत् कथ्यतां ततो ह्टत्स्थं प्रक्ष्यामस्त्वां प्रयोजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tat sarvvam shrotumichchhamo na chedu guhya mahamune |
tat kathyatam tato htatstham prakshyamastvam prayojanam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तो मुनिभिर्व्यासः प्रहस्येदमथाब्रवीत् ।
श्रूयतां भो मुनिश्रेष्ठा यदुक्तं साघु साध्विति ॥
verses.rom:
ityukto munibhirvyasah prahasyedamathabravit |
shruyatam bho munishreshtha yaduktam saghu sadhviti ||

verses.sa:
यतूकृते दशभिर्वर्षेस्त्रेतायां हायनेन यत् ।
द्रापरे यच्च मासेन अहोरात्रेण तत् कलौ ॥
verses.rom:
yatukrite dashabhirvarshestretayam hayanena yat |
drapare yachcha masena ahoratrena tat kalau ||

verses.sa:
तपसो ब्रह्यचर्य्यस्य जपादेश्व फलं द्रिजाः ।
प्राप्रोति पुरुषस्तेन कलिः साध्विति भाषितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tapaso brahyacharyyasya japadeshva phalam drijah |
praproti purushastena kalih sadhviti bhashitam ||

verses.sa:
ध्यायन् कृते यजन् यज्ञैस्त्रेतायां द्रापरेऽर्च्चयन् ।
यदाप्रोति तदाप्रोति कलौ संकीर्त्त्य केशवम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhyayan krite yajan yajnaistretayam drapare'rchchayan |
yadaproti tadaproti kalau samkirttya keshavam ||

verses.sa:
धर्म्मोतूकर्षमतीवात्र प्राप्रोति पुरुषः कलौ ।
अल्पायासेन धर्म्मज्ञास्तेन तुष्टोऽस्म्यहं कलेः ॥
verses.rom:
dharmmotukarshamativatra praproti purushah kalau |
alpayasena dharmmajnastena tushto'smyaham kaleh ||

verses.sa:
व्रतचर्य्यापरैर्ग्राह्यो वेदः पूर्व्व द्रिजातिभिः ।
ततः स्वधर्म्मसम्प्राप्तैर्यष्टव्यं विधिनाघ्वरैः ॥
verses.rom:
vratacharyyaparairgrahyo vedah purvva drijatibhih |
tatah svadharmmasampraptairyashtavyam vidhinaghvaraih ||

verses.sa:
वृथा कथा वृथाभोज्यं वृथेज्या च द्रिजन्मनाम् ।
पतनाय तथा भाव्यं तैस्त्वसंयमिभिः सदा ॥
verses.rom:
vritha katha vrithabhojyam vrithejya cha drijanmanam |
patanaya tatha bhavyam taistvasamyamibhih sada ||

verses.sa:
असम्यकूकरणे दोषस्तेषां सर्व्वेषु कर्म्मसु ।
भोज्यपेयादिकञ्चेषां नेच्छाप्राप्तिकरं द्रिजाः ॥
verses.rom:
asamyakukarane doshastesham sarvveshu karmmasu |
bhojyapeyadikanchesham nechchhapraptikaram drijah ||

verses.sa:
पारतन्व्यं समस्तेषु तेषां कार्य्यषु वै ततः ।
जयन्ति ते निजात् लोकान् क्लेशेन महता द्रिजाः ॥
verses.rom:
paratanvyam samasteshu tesham karyyashu vai tatah |
jayanti te nijat lokan kleshena mahata drijah ||

verses.sa:
द्रिजशुश्रूषयैवैष पाकयज्ञाधिकारवान् ।
निजान् जयति वै लोकाञू शूद्रो धन्यतरस्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
drijashushrushayaivaisha pakayajnadhikaravan |
nijan jayati vai lokanu shudro dhanyatarastatah ||

verses.sa:
भक्ष्याभक्ष्येषु नास्यास्ति पेयापेये वै यतः ।
नियमो मुनिशाद्दूर्लास्तेनासौ साध्वितीरितः ॥
verses.rom:
bhakshyabhakshyeshu nasyasti peyapeye vai yatah |
niyamo munishaddurlastenasau sadhvitiritah ||

verses.sa:
स्वधर्म्मस्याविरोधेन नरैलब्ध धनं सदा ।
प्रतिपादनीयं पात्रेषु रष्टव्यञ्च ययाविघि ॥
verses.rom:
svadharmmasyavirodhena narailabdha dhanam sada |
pratipadaniyam patreshu rashtavyancha yayavighi ||

verses.sa:
तस्यार्ज्जने महाक्लेशः पालने च द्रिजोत्तमाः ।
तथा सदूविनियोगाय विज्ञेयं गहनं नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyarjjane mahakleshah palane cha drijottamah |
tatha saduviniyogaya vijneyam gahanam nrinam ||

verses.sa:
एभिरन्यैस्तथा क्लेशैः पुरुषा द्रिजसत्तमाः ।
निजान् जयन्ति वै लोकान् प्राजापत्यादिकानक्रमात् ॥
verses.rom:
ebhiranyaistatha kleshaih purusha drijasattamah |
nijan jayanti vai lokan prajapatyadikanakramat ||

verses.sa:
योषिच्छुश्रूषणं भर्त्तुः कर्म्मणा मनसा गिरा ।
कुर्व्वतो समवाप्रोति तत्सालोक्यं यतो द्रिजाः ॥
verses.rom:
yoshichchhushrushanam bharttuh karmmana manasa gira |
kurvvato samavaproti tatsalokyam yato drijah ||

verses.sa:
नातिक्लेशेन महता तानेव पुरुषो यथा ।
तृतीयं व्याह्टतं तेन मया साध्विति योषितः ॥
verses.rom:
natikleshena mahata taneva purusho yatha |
tritiyam vyahtatam tena maya sadhviti yoshitah ||

verses.sa:
एतदू वः कथितं विप्रा यन्निमित्तमिहागताः ।
तत् पृच्छध्वं यथाकामं सर्व्वं वक्ष्यामि वः स्फुटटम् ॥
verses.rom:
etadu vah kathitam vipra yannimittamihagatah |
tat prichchhadhvam yathakamam sarvvam vakshyami vah sphutatam ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते मुनयः प्रोचुर्यत् प्रष्टव्यं महामुने!
अन्यस्मिन्नेव तत् पृष्टे यथावत् कथितं त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
tataste munayah prochuryat prashtavyam mahamune!
anyasminneva tat prishte yathavat kathitam tvaya ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रहस्य तान् प्राह कृष्णदूपौयनो मुनिः ।
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनांस्तापसांस्तानुपागतान ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prahasya tan praha krishnadupauyano munih |
vismayotphullanayanamstapasamstanupagatana ||

verses.sa:
मयैष भवतां प्रश्रो ज्ञातो दिव्येन चक्षुषा ।
तता हि वः प्रसङ्गने साधु साध्विति भाषितम् ॥
verses.rom:
mayaisha bhavatam prashro jnato divyena chakshusha |
tata hi vah prasangane sadhu sadhviti bhashitam ||

verses.sa:
स्वल्पेनैव प्रयत्नेन धर्म्मः सिध्यति वै कलौ ।
नरैरात्मगुणाम्भोभिः क्षालिताखिलकिल्विषौः ॥
verses.rom:
svalpenaiva prayatnena dharmmah sidhyati vai kalau |
narairatmagunambhobhih kshalitakhilakilvishauh ||

verses.sa:
शूद्रश्वै द्रिजशुश्रूषातत्परैर्मुनिसत्तमाः !
तथा स्त्रीभिरनायासं पतिशुश्रूषयैव हि ॥
verses.rom:
shudrashvai drijashushrushatatparairmunisattamah !
tatha stribhiranayasam patishushrushayaiva hi ||

verses.sa:
ततस्त्रितयमप्येतन्मम धन्यतमं मतम् ।
धर्म्मसंसाधने क्लेशो द्रिजातीनां कृतादिषु ॥
verses.rom:
tatastritayamapyetanmama dhanyatamam matam |
dharmmasamsadhane klesho drijatinam kritadishu ||

verses.sa:
भवद्भिर्यदभिप्रेतं तदेतत् कथितं मया ।
अपृष्टेनापि धर्म्मज्ञाः किमन्यत् कथ्यतां द्रिजाः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavadbhiryadabhipretam tadetat kathitam maya |
aprishtenapi dharmmajnah kimanyat kathyatam drijah ||

verses.sa:
ततः संम्पूज्य ते व्यासं प्रशस्य च पुनः पुनः ।
यथागतं द्रिजा जग्मुर्व्व्यासोक्तिक्षतसंशयाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sammpujya te vyasam prashasya cha punah punah |
yathagatam drija jagmurvvyasoktikshatasamshayah ||

verses.sa: भवतोऽपि महाभाग!रहस्यं कथितं मया ॥
verses.rom: bhavato'pi mahabhaga!rahasyam kathitam maya ||

verses.sa:
अत्यन्तदुष्टस्य कलेरयमेको महान् गुणः ।
कीर्त्तनादेव कृष्णस्य मुक्तबन्धः परं व्रजेत् ॥
verses.rom:
atyantadushtasya kalerayameko mahan gunah |
kirttanadeva krishnasya muktabandhah param vrajet ||

verses.sa:
यज्वाहं भवता पृष्टो जगतामुपसंह्टतिम् ।
प्राकृतामान्तरालाञ्च तप्मप्येष वदामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
yajvaham bhavata prishto jagatamupasamhtatim |
prakritamantaralancha tapmapyesha vadami te ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Hear, O highly illustrious one, I shall describe fully what the great Vyāsa has related upon the subject.

Once on a time, the sages assembled and discussed at what season the least morality obtained the greatest reward and by whom it was most easily displayed. In order to terminate the discussion they went to Veda Vyāsa to remove their doubts. They saw the illustrious sage, my son, immersed in the water of the Ganges, and awaiting the close of his ablutions, the sages remained on the banks of the sacred river under the shelter of a grove of trees. As my son plunged into the water and rose up from it the sages heard him exclaim. "Excellent is the Kali age". Again dived he and again did he exclaim in their hearing. "Well done, well done, Sudra, thou art happy". Again he sank down and again did they hear him say "Well done, well done, women, they are happy who are more fortunate than they". After this my son finished his bathing and the sages met him as he approached to welcome them. After they had been seated and offered their respects the son of Satyavati said to them "For what you have come here?" The Rishis said. "Having entertained some doubts regarding a subject we have come here to consult thee; but let that remain at present; explain to us some thing else. We heard you say 'Excellent is the Kali Yuga!' We are anxious to learn why this was said and why you repeatedly called them happy. Explain to us the meaning of it if it be not a mystery. We will then place before you the question that engages our thoughts".

Being thus accosted by the ascetics Vyāsa smiled and said to them "Hear excellent sages, why I said 'Well done Well done!' The fruit of penance of continence, of silent prayer and the like, practised in the Krita age for ten years, in the Treta for one year, in the Dwāpara for a month is obtained in the Kali age in a day and night; therefore I did say 'Excellent, excellent is the Kali age'. The reward, which a man obtains in the Krita age by abstract meditation in the Treta by sacrifice, in the Dwāpara by adoration, he receives, in the Kali Yuga by merely reciting the names of Kesava. O pious and great ascetics, in the Kali age, by very little exertion men attain to exalted virtue and it is for this reason I speak highly of the Kali Yuga. Formerly the Vedas were to be acquired by the twice-Born through the diligent observance of self-denial and it was their duty to celebrate sacrifices in accordance with the ritual. Thereafter, idle prayers, idle feats, fruitless ceremonies were performed, only to mislead the twice-born; for although observed by them devoutly, yet in consequence of some irregularity in their celebration sin was incurred in all these works and what they ate or what they drank did not bring about the fulfilment of their desires. In all their objects the twice-born enjoyed no independence and attained their respective spheres only with exceeding pain. On the other hand, the Sudra, more fortunate than they, attains to his assigned station by rendering their service and performing merely the sacrifice of preparing food in which no rules determine what may or may not be eaten, what may or may not be drunk. Therefore, excellent sages, the Sudra is fortunate.

"Men should acquire wealth by means not incompatible with their religious duties and it should be given to the worthy and spent upon sacrifices. There is great trouble in their acquisition as well as their preservation. And it is equally difficult for them to spend them on pious observances. O excellent Brāhmanas, by undergoing these troubles and other diverse ones people attain to the holy region of Prajāpati. A woman has only to honour her husband in act, thought and speech to reach the same region to which he is elevated and she thus accomplishes her object without any great exertion. This was the meaning of my exclamation ‘Well done' the third time. I have thus related to you what you asked. Now put to me in any way you please the question for which you came and I will make you a clear reply".

The ascetics then said to Vyāsa. "The question that we purposed to put to you has already been answered by you in your reply to our subsequent enquiry". Hearing this Krishna-Daipāyana laughed and said to the pious sages who had come to see him whose eyes were wide open with surprise. "By virtue of my divine knowledge I perceived the question you intended to put to me and in reference to this I uttered the expressions 'Well done! Well done!' In fact in the Kali age duty is performed by the mortals with very little trouble, whose sins are all washed away by the water of their individual piety—by Sudras through the diligent service of the twice-born ones and by women through the slight effort of obedience to their husbands. It is for this reason O Brāhmanas, that I did thrice express my admiration of their happiness; for in the Krita and other ages great were the toils of the regenerate to perform their duty. I did not wait for your enquiry but replied at once to the question you wanted to put. Now what do ye, conversant with virtue, wish me to tell you?"

Thereupon the ascetics saluted and praised Vyasa and freed by him from uncertainty departed as they came. I have also communicated to you. O excellent Maitreya, the secret—this one great virtue of the otherwise vicious Kali age. I shall now describe to you the dissolution of the world and the aggregation of the elements.

verses.sa:
सर्व्वेषामेव भूतानां त्रिविधः प्रितसञ्चरः ।
नैमित्तिकः प्राकृतिकस्तथैवात्यन्तिको मतः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvveshameva bhutanam trividhah pritasancharah |
naimittikah prakritikastathaivatyantiko matah ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिकस्तेषां कल्पान्ते प्रतिसञ्चरः ।
आत्यन्तिकश्व मोक्षाख्यः प्राकृतो द्रिपरार्द्धिकः ।
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
परार्द्धसंख्यां भगवन्! ममाचक्ष यया तु सः ।
द्रिगुणीकृतया ज्ञयेः प्राकृतः प्रतिसञ्चरः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmo naimittikastesham kalpante pratisancharah |
atyantikashva mokshakhyah prakrito dripararddhikah |
maitreya uvacha |
pararddhasamkhyam bhagavan! mamachaksha yaya tu sah |
drigunikritaya jnayeh prakritah pratisancharah ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
स्थानात् स्थानं दशगुणमेकस्माद् गण्यते द्रिज!
ततोऽष्टादशमे स्थाने परार्द्धमभिघीयते ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
sthanat sthanam dashagunamekasmad ganyate drija!
tato'shtadashame sthane pararddhamabhighiyate ||

verses.sa:
परार्द्धद्रिगुणं यत्तु प्राकृतः प्रलयो द्रिज!
तदाव्यक्तेऽखिलं व्यक्तं स्वहेतौ लयमेति वै ॥
verses.rom:
pararddhadrigunam yattu prakritah pralayo drija!
tadavyakte'khilam vyaktam svahetau layameti vai ||

verses.sa:
निमेषो मानुषो योऽयं मात्रामात्रप्रमाणतः ।
तैः पञ्चदशभिः काष्ठा त्रिंशत् काष्ठास्तथा कलाः ॥
verses.rom:
nimesho manusho yo'yam matramatrapramanatah |
taih panchadashabhih kashtha trimshat kashthastatha kalah ||

verses.sa:
नाड़िका तु प्रमाणेन कला दश च पञ्च च ।
उन्मानेनाम्भसः सा तु पलान्यर्द्धत्रयोदश ॥
verses.rom:
narika tu pramanena kala dasha cha pancha cha |
unmanenambhasah sa tu palanyarddhatrayodasha ||

verses.sa:
हेममाषैः कृतिच्छिद्रश्वतुर्भिश्वतुरङ्गु लैः ।
मागधेन प्रमाणेन जलप्रस्थस्तु स स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
hemamashaih kritichchhidrashvaturbhishvaturangu laih |
magadhena pramanena jalaprasthastu sa smritah ||

verses.sa:
नाड़िकाभ्यामथ द्राभ्यां मुहूर्त्तो द्रिजसत्तम!
अहोरात्रं मुहूर्त्तास्तु त्रिंशन्मासो दिनैस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
narikabhyamatha drabhyam muhurtto drijasattama!
ahoratram muhurttastu trimshanmaso dinaistatha ||

verses.sa:
मासैर्द्रादशभिर्वर्षमहोरात्रन्तु तद्दिवि ।
त्रिभिर्वर्षशतैर्वर्ष षष्ट्या चैवासुरद्रिषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
masairdradashabhirvarshamahoratrantu taddivi |
tribhirvarshashatairvarsha shashtya chaivasuradrisham ||

verses.sa:
तैस्तु द्रादसोहस्त्र चतुर्युगमुदाह्टतम् ।
चतुर्युगसहस्त्रन्तु कथ्यते ब्रह्मणो दिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
taistu dradasohastra chaturyugamudahtatam |
chaturyugasahastrantu kathyate brahmano dinam ||

verses.sa:
स कल्पोऽप्यत्र मनवश्वतुर्द्दश महामुने !
तदन्ते चैव मैत्रेय! ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको लयः ॥
verses.rom:
sa kalpo'pyatra manavashvaturddasha mahamune !
tadante chaiva maitreya! brahmo naimittiko layah ||

verses.sa:
तंस्य स्वरूपमत्युग्र मैत्रेय गदतो मम ।
श्रृणुष्व प्राकृतं भूयस्तव वक्ष्याम्यहं लयम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamsya svarupamatyugra maitreya gadato mama |
shrrinushva prakritam bhuyastava vakshyamyaham layam ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्युगसहस्त्रान्ते क्षीणप्राये महीतले ।
अनावृष्टिरतीवोग्रा जायते शतवार्षिकी ॥
verses.rom:
chaturyugasahastrante kshinapraye mahitale |
anavrishtirativogra jayate shatavarshiki ||

verses.sa:
ततो यान्यल्पसाराणि तानि तत्त्वान्यशेषतः ।
क्षयं यान्ति मुनिश्वेष्ठ!पार्थिवान्यत्र पीड़नात् ॥
verses.rom:
tato yanyalpasarani tani tattvanyasheshatah |
kshayam yanti munishveshtha!parthivanyatra piranat ||

verses.sa:
ततः स भगवान् विष्णू रुद्ररूपधरोऽव्ययः ।
क्षयाय यतते कर्त्तुमात्मस्थाः सकलाः वाजाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa bhagavan vishnu rudrarupadharo'vyayah |
kshayaya yatate karttumatmasthah sakalah vajah ||

verses.sa:
ततः स भगवान् विष्णुर्भानोः सप्तसु रश्मिषु ।
स्थितः पिबत्यशेषाणि जलानि मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa bhagavan vishnurbhanoh saptasu rashmishu |
sthitah pibatyasheshani jalani munisattama ||

verses.sa:
पीत्वार्म्भासि समस्तानि प्राणिभूमिगतानि वै ।
शोषं नयति मैत्रय!समस्तं पृथिवीतलम् ॥
verses.rom:
pitvarmbhasi samastani pranibhumigatani vai |
shosham nayati maitraya!samastam prithivitalam ||

verses.sa:
सरित्-समुद्र-शैलेषु शैल-प्रस्त्रवणेषु च ।
पातालेषु च यत्तोय तत् सर्व्वं नयति क्षयम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarit-samudra-shaileshu shaila-prastravaneshu cha |
pataleshu cha yattoya tat sarvvam nayati kshayam ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तस्यानुभावेन तोयाहारोपवृहिताः ।
त एव रश्मयः सप्त जायन्ते स्प्त भास्कराः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastasyanubhavena toyaharopavrihitah |
ta eva rashmayah sapta jayante spta bhaskarah ||

verses.sa:
अधश्वोदूर्ध्वञ्च ते दीप्यास्ततः स्पत दिंवाकराः ।
दहन्त्यशेषं त्रेलोक्यं सपातालतलं द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
adhashvodurdhvancha te dipyastatah spata dimvakarah |
dahantyashesham trelokyam sapatalatalam drija ||

verses.sa:
दह्यमानन्तु तैर्दीप्तैस्त्रैलोक्यं द्रिज!भास्करेः ।
साद्रिनद्यर्णावाभोगं निःस्नेहमति जायते ॥
verses.rom:
dahyamanantu tairdiptaistrailokyam drija!bhaskareh |
sadrinadyarnavabhogam nihsnehamati jayate ||

verses.sa:
ततो निर्दग्धवृक्षाम्बु त्रैलोक्यमखिल द्रिज!
भवत्येका च वसुधा कूर्म्मपृष्ठोपमाकृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tato nirdagdhavrikshambu trailokyamakhila drija!
bhavatyeka cha vasudha kurmmaprishthopamakritih ||

verses.sa:
ततः कालाग्रिरुद्रोऽसौ भूत्वा सर्व्वहरो हरिः ।
शेषनिः श्वाससम्भूतः पातालानि बभिस्त्यधः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kalagrirudro'sau bhutva sarvvaharo harih |
sheshanih shvasasambhutah patalani babhistyadhah ||

verses.sa:
पातालानि समस्तानि स दग्ध्वा ज्वलनो महान् ।
भूमिमभ्येत्य सकलं बभस्ति वसुधातलम् ॥
verses.rom:
patalani samastani sa dagdhva jvalano mahan |
bhumimabhyetya sakalam babhasti vasudhatalam ||

verses.sa:
भुवर्लोकं ततः सर्व्वं स्वर्लोकञ्च सुदारुणः ।
ज्वालामालामहावर्त्तस्तत्रैव परिवर्त्तते ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvarlokam tatah sarvvam svarlokancha sudarunah |
jvalamalamahavarttastatraiva parivarttate ||

verses.sa:
अम्बरीषमिवाभाति त्रैलोक्यमखिलं तदा ।
ज्वालावर्त्तपरीवारमुपक्षीणचराचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ambarishamivabhati trailokyamakhilam tada |
jvalavarttaparivaramupakshinacharacharam ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तापपरीतास्तु लोकदूयनिवासिनः ।
कृताधिकारा गच्छन्ति महर्लोकं महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
tatastapaparitastu lokaduyanivasinah |
kritadhikara gachchhanti maharlokam mahamune ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादपि महातापतप्ता लोकास्ततः परम् ।
गच्छन्ति जनलोकं ते दशावृत्त्या परैषिणः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadapi mahatapatapta lokastatah param |
gachchhanti janalokam te dashavrittya paraishinah ||

verses.sa:
ततो दग्ध्वा जगत् सर्व्वं रुद्ररूपी जनार्द्दनः।
मुखनिःश्वासजान् मेघान् करोति मुनिसत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato dagdhva jagat sarvvam rudrarupi janarddanah|
mukhanihshvasajan meghan karoti munisattam ||

verses.sa:
ततो गजकुलप्रख्यास्तड़ित्वन्तो निनादिनः ।
उत्तिष्ठन्ति तदा व्योम्रि घोराः संवर्त्तका घनाः ॥
verses.rom:
tato gajakulaprakhyastaritvanto ninadinah |
uttishthanti tada vyomri ghorah samvarttaka ghanah ||

verses.sa:
केचिन्नीलोतूपलश्यामाः केचित् कुमुदसन्निभाः ।
धूमवर्णा घनाः केचित् केचित् पीताः परोधराः ॥
verses.rom:
kechinnilotupalashyamah kechit kumudasannibhah |
dhumavarna ghanah kechit kechit pitah parodharah ||

verses.sa:
केचिद्रासभवर्णाभा लाक्षारसनिभास्तथा ।
केचिद्रैदूर्य्यसङ्काशा इन्द्रनीलनिभाः परे ॥
verses.rom:
kechidrasabhavarnabha laksharasanibhastatha |
kechidraiduryyasankasha indranilanibhah pare ||

verses.sa:
शङ्खकुन्दनिभाश्वान्ये जात्यञ्जननिबास्तथा ।
इन्द्रगोपनिभाः केचिनूमनः शिलनिभास्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
shankhakundanibhashvanye jatyanjananibastatha |
indragopanibhah kechinumanah shilanibhastatha ||

verses.sa:
चाषपत्रनिभाः केचिदुत्तिष्ठन्ति घना घनाः ।
केचित् पुरवरावकाराः केचित् पर्व्वतसन्नभाः ॥
verses.rom:
chashapatranibhah kechiduttishthanti ghana ghanah |
kechit puravaravakarah kechit parvvatasannabhah ||

verses.sa:
कूटागारनिभाश्वान्ये केचित् स्थूलनिभा घनाः ।
महारावा महाकायाः पूरयन्ति नभस्तलम् ॥
verses.rom:
kutagaranibhashvanye kechit sthulanibha ghanah |
maharava mahakayah purayanti nabhastalam ||

verses.sa:
वर्षन्तस्ते महासारै-स्तमग्रिमतिभैरवम् ।
शमयन्त्यखिलं विप्र! त्रैलोक्यान्तरविस्तृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
varshantaste mahasarai-stamagrimatibhairavam |
shamayantyakhilam vipra! trailokyantaravistritam ||

verses.sa:
नष्टे चाग्रौ शतं तेऽपि वर्षाणामनिवारिताः ।
प्लावयन्तो जगत् सर्वं वर्षन्ति मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
nashte chagrau shatam te'pi varshanamanivaritah |
plavayanto jagat sarvam varshanti munisattama ||

verses.sa:
धाराभिरक्षमात्राभिः प्लावयित्वाखिलं भुवम् ।
भुवर्लोकं तथैवोर्द्ध्व प्लावयन्ति दिवं द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
dharabhirakshamatrabhih plavayitvakhilam bhuvam |
bhuvarlokam tathaivorddhva plavayanti divam drija ||

verses.sa:
अन्धरारीकृते लोके नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे ।
वर्षन्ति ते महामेघा वर्षाणामधिकं शतम ॥
verses.rom:
andhararikrite loke nashte sthavarajangame |
varshanti te mahamegha varshanamadhikam shatama ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said The dissolution of existing beings is of three kinds, incidental, elemental and absolute. The incidental is that which relates to Brahmā and takes place at the end of a Kalpa: the elemental is that which occurs after two Parārdhas; the absolute is final liberation from existence.

Maitreya said:—"Tell me, O excellent preceptor, what is the enumeration of a Parārdha, the expiration of two of which is the period of elemental dissolution".

Parāçara said:—Parardha, O Maitreya, is that number which takes place in the eighteenth place of figures enumerated according to the rule of decimal notation. At the end of twice that period elemental dissolution takes place when all the discrete products of nature are withdrawn into Their indiscrete source. The shortest period of time is Mātrā which is equal to the twinkling of the human eye; fifteen Mātrā make a Kāshthā; thirty Kāshthās one Kalā: fifteen Kalās one Nādhikā. A Nādhikā is determined by a measure of water with a vessel made of twelve Palas and a half of copper in the bottom of which there is to be a hole made with a tube of gold of the weight of four Māshas and four inches long. According to the Māgadha measure the vessel should hold a Prastha (or sixteen Palas) of water. Two of these Nādis make one Muhurta; thirty of which make one day and night. Thirty such periods constitute a month; twelve months make a year, or a day and night of the celestials; and three hundred and sixty such days, constitute a year of the celestials. An aggregate of four ages consists of twelve thousand divine years; and a thousand periods of four ages complete a day of Brahmā. That period is also termed a Kalpa during which fourteen Munis preside and at the end of it takes place the incidental or Brahmā dissolution. The nature of this dissolution is very dreadful; hear, I shall describe this as well as that which takes place as the elemental dissolution.

At the end of a thousand period of four ages the earth is for the most part exhausted. A total dearth takes place which lasts for a hundred years; and on account of the failure of food all beings become languid and exanimate and at last entirely die. The eternal Vishnu then takes the character of Rudra the destroyer and comes down to reunite all his creatures with himself. He enters into the seven rays of the sun, drinks up all the waters of the earth and causes all moisture, whatever in living bodies or in the soil to evaporate, thus drying up the whole earth. Thus fed with his intervention with profuse moisture, the seven solar rays dilate to seven suns, whose radiance glows above, below and on every side and sets the three worlds and Pātāla on fire. The three worlds, consumed by these suns, become rugged and deformed all over their mountains, rivers and seas; and the earth bare of verdure, and destitute of moisture alone remains resembling in appearance the back of a tortoise. Hari, the destroyer of all things, in the form of Rudra, who is the flame of time, becomes the scorching breath of the serpent Sesha and thereby reduces Pātāla to ashes. The great fire, when it has reduced all the divisions of Pātāla to ashes, proceeds to the earth and consumes it also. A vast whirlpool of eddying flame then spreads to the region of the atmosphere and the sphere of the celestials and wraps them in ruin. The three spheres shew like a frying pan amidst the surrounding flames that prey upon all movable and stationary things. O great saint, the inhabitants of the two upper spheres, having satisfied their respective duties and being assailed by the heat, repair to Maharloka. When that becomes heated its inhabitants, who after the full period of stay, are desirous of ascending to higher regions depart for the Janaloka.

Having consumed the whole universe in the person of Rudra, Janārddana, breathes fourth heavy clouds, and those called Samvartta resembling huge elephants in bulk overspread the sky, roaring and darting lightnings. Some are as white as the water-lily, some are dusky like smoke; some are yellow; some are of a dun colour, like that of an ass; some like ashes sprinkled on the forehead; some are deep blue, as the lapis lazuly; some azure like the sapphire; some are white at the couch or the jasmine; some are black as colly rum; some are like the lady-bird; some are of fierceness of red arsenic and some are like the wing of the painted joy. Such is the colour of these massy clouds; in form some resemble towns, some mountains, some are like houses and hovels and some are like columns. Huge in size and loud in thunder they fill space. Showering down torrents of water, those clouds quench the dreadful fires which involve the three worlds and then rain incessantly a hundred years and deluge the whole universe. Showering down in drops as large as dice these rains overspread the earth and fill the middle region and inundate the celestial sphere. The world is now enshrouded in darkness and all things animate and inanimate having perished, the clouds continue to pour down waters for more than a hundred years.

verses.sa:
सप्तर्षिस्थानमाक्रम्य स्थितेऽम्भसि महामुने!
एकाणवं भवत्येव त्रैलोक्यमखिलं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
saptarshisthanamakramya sthite'mbhasi mahamune!
ekanavam bhavatyeva trailokyamakhilam tatah ||

verses.sa:
मुखनिः श्वासजो विष्णोर्वायुस्तान् जलदांस्ततः ।
नाशयित्वा तु मैत्रेय!वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
mukhanih shvasajo vishnorvayustan jaladamstatah |
nashayitva tu maitreya!varshanamadhikam shatam ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वभूतमयोऽचिन्त्यो भगवान् बूतभावनः ।
अनादिरादिर्विश्वस्य पीत्वा वायुमशेषतः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvabhutamayo'chintyo bhagavan butabhavanah |
anadiradirvishvasya pitva vayumasheshatah ||

verses.sa:
एकार्णावे ततस्तस्मिन् शेषशय्यास्थितः प्रभुः ।
ब्रह्मरूपधरः शेते भगवानादिकृद्धरिः ॥
verses.rom:
ekarnave tatastasmin sheshashayyasthitah prabhuh |
brahmarupadharah shete bhagavanadikriddharih ||

verses.sa:
जनलोकगतैः सिद्धेः सनकाद्यरैभिष्टुतः ।
ब्रह्मलोकगतैश्चैव चिन्त्यमानो मुमुक्षुबिः ॥
verses.rom:
janalokagataih siddheh sanakadyaraibhishtutah |
brahmalokagataishchaiva chintyamano mumukshubih ||

verses.sa:
आत्ममायामयीं दिव्यां योगनिद्रां समास्थितः ।
आत्मानं वासुदेवाख्यं चिन्तयन् परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
atmamayamayim divyam yoganidram samasthitah |
atmanam vasudevakhyam chintayan parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
एष नैमित्तिको नाम मैत्रेय!प्रतिसञ्चरः ।
निमित्तं तत्र यच्छेते ब्रह्मरूपधरो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
esha naimittiko nama maitreya!pratisancharah |
nimittam tatra yachchhete brahmarupadharo harih ||

verses.sa:
यदा जागर्त्ति विश्वात्मा स तदा चेष्टते जगत् ।
निमीलत्येतदखिलं योगशय्याशयेऽच्युते ॥
verses.rom:
yada jagartti vishvatma sa tada cheshtate jagat |
nimilatyetadakhilam yogashayyashaye'chyute ||

verses.sa:
पद्मयोनेर्दिनं यत्तु चतुर्युगसहस्त्रवत् ।
एकार्णावाप्लुते लोके तावती रात्रिष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
padmayonerdinam yattu chaturyugasahastravat |
ekarnavaplute loke tavati ratrishyate ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रबुद्धो रात्र्यन्ते पुनः सृष्टिं करोत्यजः ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूप धृग् विष्णुर्यथा ते कथितं पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabuddho ratryante punah srishtim karotyajah |
brahmasvarupa dhrig vishnuryatha te kathitam pura ||

verses.sa:
इत्येष कल्पसंहारश्वान्तरः प्रलयो द्रिज!
नैमित्तिकस्ते कथितः प्राकृतः श्वृण्वतः परम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityesha kalpasamharashvantarah pralayo drija!
naimittikaste kathitah prakritah shvrinvatah param ||

verses.sa:
अनावृष्ट्याग्रिसम्पर्कात् कृतै संक्षालने मुने!
समस्तेष्वेव लोकेषु पातालेष्वखिलेषु च ॥
verses.rom:
anavrishtyagrisamparkat kritai samkshalane mune!
samasteshveva lokeshu pataleshvakhileshu cha ||

verses.sa:
महदादेर्विकारस्य विशेषान्तस्य संक्षये ।
कृष्णेच्छाकारिते तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते प्रतिसञ्चरे ॥
verses.rom:
mahadadervikarasya visheshantasya samkshaye |
krishnechchhakarite tasmin pravritte pratisanchare ||

verses.sa:
आपो ग्रसन्ति वै पूर्व्वं भूमेर्गन्धात्मकं गुणाम् ।
आत्तगन्धा ततो भूमिः प्रलयत्वाय कल्पते ॥
verses.rom:
apo grasanti vai purvvam bhumergandhatmakam gunam |
attagandha tato bhumih pralayatvaya kalpate ||

verses.sa:
प्रनष्टे गन्धतन्मात्रेऽभवत् पृथ्वी जलात्मिका ।
रसाज्जल समुद्भूतं तस्माज्जातं रसात्मकम् ॥
verses.rom:
pranashte gandhatanmatre'bhavat prithvi jalatmika |
rasajjala samudbhutam tasmajjatam rasatmakam ||

verses.sa:
आपस्तदा प्रवृद्धास्तु वेगवत्यो महास्वनाः ।
सर्व्वमापूरयन्तीदं तिष्ठन्ति विचरन्ति च ।
सलिलेनैवोर्म्मिमता लोका व्याप्ताः समन्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
apastada pravriddhastu vegavatyo mahasvanah |
sarvvamapurayantidam tishthanti vicharanti cha |
salilenaivormmimata loka vyaptah samantatah ||

verses.sa:
अपामपि गुणो यस्तु ज्योतिषा पीयते तु सः ।
नश्यन्त्यापस्ततस्ताश्व रसतन्मात्रसंक्षयात् ॥
verses.rom:
apamapi guno yastu jyotisha piyate tu sah |
nashyantyapastatastashva rasatanmatrasamkshayat ||

verses.sa:
ततश्वापो ह्टतरसा ज्योतिष्ट्वं प्राप्नुवन्ति वै ।
अग्न्यवस्थे तु सलिले तेजसा सर्व्वतो वृते ॥
verses.rom:
tatashvapo htatarasa jyotishtvam prapnuvanti vai |
agnyavasthe tu salile tejasa sarvvato vrite ||

verses.sa:
स चाग्रिः सर्व्वतो व्याप्य आदत्ते तज्जल तदा ।
सर्व्वमापूर्य्य तेजोभिस्तदा जगदिदं शनैः ॥
verses.rom:
sa chagrih sarvvato vyapya adatte tajjala tada |
sarvvamapuryya tejobhistada jagadidam shanaih ||

verses.sa:
अर्ज्जिर्भिः संवृ-ते तस्मिन् तिर्य्यगूर्द्ध मधस्तथा ।
ज्योतिषोऽपि परं रूपं वायुरत्ति प्रभाकरम् ॥
verses.rom:
arjjirbhih samvri-te tasmin tiryyagurddha madhastatha |
jyotisho'pi param rupam vayuratti prabhakaram ||

verses.sa:
प्रलीने च ततस्तस्मिन् वायुभूतेऽखिलात्मनि ।
प्रनष्टे रूपतन्मात्रे ह्टतरूपो विभावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
praline cha tatastasmin vayubhute'khilatmani |
pranashte rupatanmatre htatarupo vibhavasuh ||

verses.sa:
प्रशाम्यति तदा ज्योतिर्वायुर्दोधूयते महान् ।
निरालोके तदा लोके वाय्वस्थे च तेजसि ॥
verses.rom:
prashamyati tada jyotirvayurdodhuyate mahan |
niraloke tada loke vayvasthe cha tejasi ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तु मूलमासाद्य वायुः सम्भवमात्मनः ।
ऊर्द्ध्वञ्चाधश्व तिर्य्यक् च दोधवीति दिशो दश ॥
verses.rom:
tatastu mulamasadya vayuh sambhavamatmanah |
urddhvanchadhashva tiryyak cha dodhaviti disho dasha ||

verses.sa:
वायारपिं गुणां स्पर्शमाकाशो ग्रसते पुनः ।
प्रशाम्यति ततो वायुः स्वन्तु तिष्ठत्यनावृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayarapim gunam sparshamakasho grasate punah |
prashamyati tato vayuh svantu tishthatyanavritam ||

verses.sa:
अरूपमरसस्पर्शमगन्धं न च मूर्त्तिमत् ।
सर्व्वमापूरयच्चैनत् सुमहत् सम्प्रकाशते ॥
verses.rom:
arupamarasasparshamagandham na cha murttimat |
sarvvamapurayachchainat sumahat samprakashate ||

verses.sa:
परिमण्डल तच्छुषिरमाकाशं शब्दलक्षणम् ।
शब्दमात्रं तदाकाशं सर्व्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
parimandala tachchhushiramakasham shabdalakshanam |
shabdamatram tadakasham sarvvamavritya tishthati ||

verses.sa:
ततः शब्दं गुणां तस्य भूतादिर्ग्रसते पुनः ।
भूतेन्द्रियेषु युगपद् भूतादौ संस्तितेषु वै ॥
verses.rom:
tatah shabdam gunam tasya bhutadirgrasate punah |
bhutendriyeshu yugapad bhutadau samstiteshu vai ||

verses.sa:
अभिमानात्मको ह्येष बूतादिस्तामसः स्मृतः ।
भूतादिं ग्रसते चापि महान् वै वुद्धिलक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
abhimanatmako hyesha butadistamasah smritah |
bhutadim grasate chapi mahan vai vuddhilakshanah ||

verses.sa: उर्व्वी महांश्व जगतः प्रान्तेऽन्वर्बाह्यतस्तथा ॥
verses.rom: urvvi mahamshva jagatah prante'nvarbahyatastatha ||

verses.sa:
एवं स्पत महाबद्ध! क्रमात् प्रकृतयस्तु वै ।
प्रत्याहारे तु ताः सर्व्वाः प्रविशन्ति परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
evam spata mahabaddha! kramat prakritayastu vai |
pratyahare tu tah sarvvah pravishanti parasparam ||

verses.sa:
येनेदमावृतं सर्व्वमण्डमप्सु प्रलीयते ।
सप्तद्रीपसमुद्रान्तं सप्तलोकं सपर्ट्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yenedamavritam sarvvamandamapsu praliyate |
saptadripasamudrantam saptalokam sapartvatam ||

verses.sa:
उदकावरणं यत्तु ज्योतिषा पीयते तु तत् ।
ज्योतिर्वायौ ल्यं याति यात्याकाशे समीरणः ॥
verses.rom:
udakavaranam yattu jyotisha piyate tu tat |
jyotirvayau lyam yati yatyakashe samiranah ||

verses.sa:
आकाशञ्चैव भूतादिर्ग्रसते तं तदा महान् ।
महान्तमेबिः सहितं प्रकृतिर्ग्रसते द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
akashanchaiva bhutadirgrasate tam tada mahan |
mahantamebih sahitam prakritirgrasate drija ||

verses.sa:
गुणसाम्यमनुद्रिक्तमन्यूनञ्च महामुने!
प्रोच्यते प्रकृतिर्हेतुः प्रधानं काराण परम् ॥
verses.rom:
gunasamyamanudriktamanyunancha mahamune!
prochyate prakritirhetuh pradhanam karana param ||

verses.sa:
इत्येषा प्रकृतिः सर्व्वा व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपिणी ।
व्यक्तस्वरूपमव्यक्ते तस्मिन् मैत्रेय!लीयते ॥
verses.rom:
ityesha prakritih sarvva vyaktavyaktasvarupini |
vyaktasvarupamavyakte tasmin maitreya!liyate ||

verses.sa:
एकः शुद्धोऽक्षरो नित्यः सर्वव्यापी तथा पुमान् ।
सोऽप्यंशः सर्वभूतस्य मैत्रेय!परमात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
ekah shuddho'ksharo nityah sarvavyapi tatha puman |
so'pyamshah sarvabhutasya maitreya!paramatmanah ||

verses.sa:
न सन्ति यत्र सर्वेशे नामजात्यादिकल्पनाः ।
सत्तामात्रात्मके ज्ञये ज्ञानात्मन्यात्मनः परे ॥
verses.rom:
na santi yatra sarveshe namajatyadikalpanah |
sattamatratmake jnaye jnanatmanyatmanah pare ||

verses.sa:
स ब्रह्म तत् परं धाम परमात्मा स चेश्वरः ।
स विष्णुः सर्वमेवेदं यतो नावर्त्तते यतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa brahma tat param dhama paramatma sa cheshvarah |
sa vishnuh sarvamevedam yato navarttate yatih ||

verses.sa:
प्रकृतिर्या मया ख्याता व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपिणी ।
पुरुषश्चाप्युभावेतौ लीयेते परमात्मनि ॥
verses.rom:
prakritirya maya khyata vyaktavyaktasvarupini |
purushashchapyubhavetau liyete paramatmani ||

verses.sa:
परमात्मा च सर्वेषामाधारः परमेश्वरः ।
विष्णुर्नाम्रा स वेदेषु वेदान्तेषु च गीयते ॥
verses.rom:
paramatma cha sarveshamadharah parameshvarah |
vishnurnamra sa vedeshu vedanteshu cha giyate ||

verses.sa:
प्रवृत्तञ्च निवृत्तञ्च द्रिविधं कर्म्म वैदिकम् ।
ताभ्यामुभाभ्यां पुरुषैः सर्वमूर्त्तिः स इज्यते ॥
verses.rom:
pravrittancha nivrittancha drividham karmma vaidikam |
tabhyamubhabhyam purushaih sarvamurttih sa ijyate ||

verses.sa:
ऋगू-यजुः-सामबिर्मार्गैः प्रवृत्तैरिज्यते ह्यसौ ।
यज्ञेश्वरो यज्ञपुमान् पुरुषैः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
rigu-yajuh-samabirmargaih pravrittairijyate hyasau |
yajneshvaro yajnapuman purushaih purushottamah ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानात्मा ज्ञानयोगेन ज्ञानमूर्त्तिः स चेज्यते ।
निवृत्ते योगिभिर्मुर्गेविष्णुर्मुक्तिफलप्रदः ॥
verses.rom:
jnanatma jnanayogena jnanamurttih sa chejyate |
nivritte yogibhirmurgevishnurmuktiphalapradah ||

verses.sa:
ह्टस्व-दीर्घ-प्लुतैर्यत्तु किञ्चिदूस्त्वभियुज्यते ।
यच्च वाचामविषये तत्सर्वं विष्णुख्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
htasva-dirgha-plutairyattu kinchidustvabhiyujyate |
yachcha vachamavishaye tatsarvam vishnukhyayah ||

verses.sa:
व्यक्तं स एव चाव्यक्तं स एव पुरुषोऽव्ययः ।
परमात्मा स विश्वात्मा विश्वरूपधरो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
vyaktam sa eva chavyaktam sa eva purusho'vyayah |
paramatma sa vishvatma vishvarupadharo harih ||

verses.sa:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मिका तस्मिन् प्रकृतिः सम्प्रलीयते ।
पुरुषश्वापि मैत्रेय!व्यापिन्यव्याहतात्मनि ॥
verses.rom:
vyaktavyaktatmika tasmin prakritih sampraliyate |
purushashvapi maitreya!vyapinyavyahatatmani ||

verses.sa:
द्रिपरार्द्धात्मकः कालः कथितो यो मया तव ।
तदहस्तस्य मैत्रेय!विष्णोरीशस्य कथ्यते ॥
verses.rom:
dripararddhatmakah kalah kathito yo maya tava |
tadahastasya maitreya!vishnorishasya kathyate ||

verses.sa:
व्यक्ते च प्रकृतौ लीने प्रकृत्यां पुरुषे तथा ।
तत्र स्थिते निशा चान्या ततूप्रमाणा महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
vyakte cha prakritau line prakrityam purushe tatha |
tatra sthite nisha chanya tatupramana mahamune ||

verses.sa:
नैवाहस्तस्य न निशा नित्यस्य परमात्मनः ।
उपचारस्तथाप्येष तस्येशस्य द्रिजोच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
naivahastasya na nisha nityasya paramatmanah |
upacharastathapyesha tasyeshasya drijochyate ||

verses.sa:
इत्येष तव मैत्रेय!कथितः प्राकृतो लयः ।
आत्यन्तिकमितो ब्रह्मन्निबोध प्रतिसञ्चरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityesha tava maitreya!kathitah prakrito layah |
atyantikamito brahmannibodha pratisancharam ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—O great ascetic, the waters having reached the region of the seven Rishis the whole of three worlds becomes one ocean. The breath of Vishnu, thereupon, becomes a strong wind, which blows for more than a hundred years until all the clouds are dispersed. The wind is then re-absorbed and he, of whom all beings are made, the lord by whom all things exist, he, who is inconceivable, without beginning of the universe, reposes sleeping upon Sesha in the midst of the ocean. The creator Hari, sleeps upon the ocean in the form of Brahmā glorified by Sanaka and the saints who had departed to the Janaloka and contemplated by the holy inhabitants of Brahmaloka, anxious for final liberation—involved in mystic slumber, the celestial personification of his own illusions and meditating on his own ineffable spirit which is called Vāsudeva. This, O Majtreya, is the dissolution called incidental, because, Hari, in the form of Brahmā, sleeps there as its incidental cause.

When the universal spirit wakes, the world revives: when he clears his eyes, all things fall upon the bed of mystic sleep. In the same manner a thousand great eyes comprise a day of Brahmā so his night consists of the same period: during which the world is submerged by a vast ocean. Awaking at the end of his night the unborn Vishnu, in the character of Brahmā, creates the universe anew in the manner formerly described unto you. I have thus related to you the intermediate dissolution of the world taking place at the end of every Kalpa. I will now, O Maitreya, describe to you elemental dissolution. When by dearth and fire all the worlds and Patalas are dried up and the modification of Mahat and other products of nature are by the will of Krishna destroyed the progress of elemental dissolution is begun. At first the waters swallow up the property of earth which is the rudiment of smell; and earth, deprived of its property, proceeds to destruction. Devoid of the rudiment of odour the earth becomes identical with water. The water then being much increased roaring and rushing along fill up all space whether agitated or still. When the universe is thus pervaded by the waves of the watery element its rudimental flavour is licked up by the element of fire and on account of the destruction of these rudiments the waters themselves are destroyed. Devoid of the essential element of flavour they become identical with fire and the universe is therefore entirely filled with flame which drinks up the water on every side and gradually overspreads the whole of the world. While space is envelope in flame above, below and all around the element of the wind seizes upon the rudimental property or form which is the cause of light, and that being withdrawn, all becomes of the nature of air. The rudiment of form being destroyed and fire deprived of its rudiment, air extinguishes fire and spreads resistlessly over space which is deprived of when fire mages into air. Air then accompanied by sound which is the source of ether, extends everywhere throughout the ten regions of space until ether seizes upon contact, its rudimental property; by the loss of which air is destroyed and ether remains unchanged: devoid of form, flavour, touch and smell, it exists unembodied and vast and pervades the whole of space. Ether, whose characteristic property and rudiment is sound exists alone occupying all the vacuity of space. At then the radical element egotism devours sound and all the elements and faculties are at once merged into their original. This primary element is conscientiousness combined with the property of darkness and is itself swallowed up by Mahat whose characteristic property is intelligence; and earth and Mahat are the inner and outer boundaries of the universe. In this manner, as in the creation were the seven forms of nature (Prakriti) reckoned from Mahat to earth; so at the time of elemental dissolution these seven successively re-enter into each other. The egg of Brahmā is dissolved in the waters that surround it, with its seven zones, seven oceans, seven regions, and their mountains. The investure of water is drunk up by fire; the stratum of fire is absorbed by that of air: air blends itself with ether; the primary element of egotism devours the ether and is itself taken up by intellect, which, along with all those, is seized upon by nature. Equilibrium of the three properties, without excess or deficiency, is called nature (Prakriti), origin (Hetu), the chief Principle (Pradhāna) cause (Kārana), supreme (Param). This Prakriti is essentially the same, whether discrete or indiscrete; only that which is discrete finally is lost or absorbed in the indiscrete. Spirit also which is one, pure, imperishable, eternal, all-pervading is a portion of that supreme spirit which is all things. That spirit which is other than embodied spirit, in which there are no attributes of name, species or the like—which is one with all wisdom and is to be understood as sole existence, that is Brahmā, infinite glory, supreme spirit, supreme power, Vishnu, all that is from whence the perfect sage returns no more. Prakriti, which I have described to you as being essentially both discrete and indiscrete and spirit both resolve into spirit, supreme spirit is the upholder of all things and the ruler of all things and is glorified in the Vedas and in the Vedanta by the name of Vishnu.

Works as sanctioned by the Vedas are of two kinds, active and quiescent; by both of which the universal person is worshipped by mankind. He, the lord of sacrifice, the male of sacrifice, the most excellent Purusha, is worshipped by men in the active mode, by rites enjoined in the Rik, Yayur and Sama Vedas. The soul of wisdom, the person of wisdom, Vishnu, the giver of emancipation is worshipped by the sages in the quiescent form through meditative devotion. The exhaustless Vishnu is whatever thing that is designated by long, short or prolated syllables or that which is without a name. He is that which is dissolute or that which is indescrete: he is exhaustless spirit, supreme spirit, universal spirit, Hari, the assumer of universal forms. Nature, discrete or indiscrete is absorbed unto him, and spirit also merges into the all diffusive and unobstructed spirit. The period of two Parārdhas, as I have related to you, O Maitreya, constitutes a day of that powerful Vishnu, and whilst the products of nature are merged into this source, nature into spirit and that into the supreme, that period is called his night and is of equal duration with his day. But in reality, to that supreme spirit there is neither day nor night and these distinctions are only figuratively applied to the Almighty. I have thus explained to you the nature of elemental dissolution and will now explain to you which is final.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
आध्यात्मिकादि मैत्रेय ज्ञात्वा तापत्रयं बुधः ।
उत्पन्नज्ञानवैराग्यः प्राप्नोत्यात्यंतिकं लयम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
adhyatmikadi maitreya jnatva tapatrayam budhah |
utpannajnanavairagyah prapnotyatyamtikam layam ||

verses.sa:
आध्यात्मिकोपि द्विविधश्शरीरो मानसस्तथा ।
शरीरो बहुभिर्भेदैर्भिद्यते श्रूयतां च सः ॥
verses.rom:
adhyatmikopi dvividhashshariro manasastatha |
shariro bahubhirbhedairbhidyate shruyatam cha sah ||

verses.sa:
शिरोरोगप्रतिश्यायज्वरशूलभगंदरैः ।
गुल्मार्शःश्वयथुश्वासच्छर्द्यादिभिरनेकधा ॥
verses.rom:
shirorogapratishyayajvarashulabhagamdaraih |
gulmarshahshvayathushvasachchhardyadibhiranekadha ||

verses.sa:
तथाक्षिरोगातीसारकुष्ठांगामयसंज्ञितैः ।
भिद्यते देहजस्तापो मानसं श्रोतुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
tathakshirogatisarakushthamgamayasamjnitaih |
bhidyate dehajastapo manasam shrotumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
कामक्रोधभयद्वेषलोभमोहविषादजः ।
शोकासूयावमानेर्ष्यामात्सर्यादिमयस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
kamakrodhabhayadveshalobhamohavishadajah |
shokasuyavamanershyamatsaryadimayastatha ||

verses.sa:
मानसोऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठ तापो भवति नैकधा।
इत्येवमादिभिर्भेदैस्तापो ह्याध्यात्मिकः स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
manaso'pi dvijashreshtha tapo bhavati naikadha|
ityevamadibhirbhedaistapo hyadhyatmikah smritah ||

verses.sa:
मृगपक्षिमनुष्याद्यैः पिशाचोरगराक्षसैः ।
सरीसृपाद्यैश्च नृणां जायते चाधिभौतिकः ॥
verses.rom:
mrigapakshimanushyadyaih pishachoragarakshasaih |
sarisripadyaishcha nrinam jayate chadhibhautikah ||

verses.sa:
शीतवा तोष्णवर्षांबुवैद्युतादिसमुद्भवः ।
तापो द्विजवरश्रेष्ठैः कथ्यते चाधिदैविकः ॥
verses.rom:
shitava toshnavarshambuvaidyutadisamudbhavah |
tapo dvijavarashreshthaih kathyate chadhidaivikah ||

verses.sa:
गर्भजन्मजराज्ञानमृत्युनारकजं तथा ।
दुःखं सहस्रशो भेदैर्भिद्यते मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
garbhajanmajarajnanamrityunarakajam tatha |
duhkham sahasrasho bhedairbhidyate munisattama ||

verses.sa:
सुकुमारतनुर्गर्भे जंतुर्बहुमलावृते ।
उल्वसंवेष्टितो भुग्नपृष्ठग्रीवास्थिसंहतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sukumaratanurgarbhe jamturbahumalavrite |
ulvasamveshtito bhugnaprishthagrivasthisamhatih ||

verses.sa:
अत्यम्लकटुतीक्ष्णोष्णलवणैर्मातृभोजनैः ।
अत्यंततापैरत्यर्थं वर्द्धमानातिवेदनः ॥
verses.rom:
atyamlakatutikshnoshnalavanairmatribhojanaih |
atyamtatapairatyartham varddhamanativedanah ||

verses.sa:
प्रसारणाकुंचनादौ नांगानां प्रभुरात्मनः ।
शकृन्मूत्रमहापंकशायी सर्वत्र पीडितः ॥
verses.rom:
prasaranakumchanadau namganam prabhuratmanah |
shakrinmutramahapamkashayi sarvatra piditah ||

verses.sa:
निरुच्छ्वासः सचैतन्यस्स्मरञ्जन्मशतान्यथ ।
आस्ते गर्भेऽतिदुःखेन निजकर्मनिबंधनः ॥
verses.rom:
niruchchhvasah sachaitanyassmaranjanmashatanyatha |
aste garbhe'tiduhkhena nijakarmanibamdhanah ||

verses.sa:
जायमानः पुरीषासृङ्मूत्रशुक्राविलाननः ।
प्राजापत्येन वातेन पीड्यमानास्थिबंधनः ॥
verses.rom:
jayamanah purishasrinmutrashukravilananah |
prajapatyena vatena pidyamanasthibamdhanah ||

verses.sa:
अधोमुखो वै क्रियते प्रबलैस्सूतिमारुतैः ।
क्लेशान्निष्क्रांतिमाप्नोति जठरान्मातुरातुरः ॥
verses.rom:
adhomukho vai kriyate prabalaissutimarutaih |
kleshannishkramtimapnoti jatharanmaturaturah ||

verses.sa:
मूर्च्छामवाप्य महतीं संस्पृष्टो बाह्यवायुना ।
विज्ञानभ्रंशमाप्नोति जातश्च मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
murchchhamavapya mahatim samsprishto bahyavayuna |
vijnanabhramshamapnoti jatashcha munisattama ||

verses.sa:
कंटकैरिव तुन्नांगः क्रकचैरिव दारितः ।
पूतिव्रणान्निपतितो धरण्यां क्रिमिको यथा ॥
verses.rom:
kamtakairiva tunnamgah krakachairiva daritah |
putivranannipatito dharanyam krimiko yatha ||

verses.sa:
कंडूयनेऽपि चाशक्तः परिवर्त्तेप्यनीश्वरः ।
स्नानपानादिकाहारमप्याप्नोति परेच्छया ॥
verses.rom:
kamduyane'pi chashaktah parivarttepyanishvarah |
snanapanadikaharamapyapnoti parechchhaya ||

verses.sa:
अशुचिप्रस्तरे सुप्तः कीटदंशादिभिस्तथा ।
भक्ष्यमाणोऽपि नैवैषां समर्थो विनिवारणे ॥
verses.rom:
ashuchiprastare suptah kitadamshadibhistatha |
bhakshyamano'pi naivaisham samartho vinivarane ||

verses.sa:
जन्मदुःखान्यनेकानि जन्मनोनंतराणि च ।
बालभावे यदाप्नोति ह्याधिभौतादिकानि च ॥
verses.rom:
janmaduhkhanyanekani janmanonamtarani cha |
balabhave yadapnoti hyadhibhautadikani cha ||

verses.sa:
अज्ञानतमसाच्छन्नो मूढांतःकरणो नरः ।
न जानाति कुतः कोहं क्वाहं गंता किमात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
ajnanatamasachchhanno mudhamtahkarano narah |
na janati kutah koham kvaham gamta kimatmanah ||

verses.sa:
केन बंधेन बद्धोहं कारणं किमकारणम् ।
किं कार्यं किमकार्यं वा किं वाच्यं किं च नोच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
kena bamdhena baddhoham karanam kimakaranam |
kim karyam kimakaryam va kim vachyam kim cha nochyate ||

verses.sa:
को धर्मः कश्च वाऽधर्मः कस्मिन्वर्त्तेऽथ वा कथम् ।
किं कर्त्तव्यमकर्त्तव्यं किं वा किंगुणदोषवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ko dharmah kashcha va'dharmah kasminvartte'tha va katham |
kim karttavyamakarttavyam kim va kimgunadoshavat ||

verses.sa:
एवं पशुसमैर्मुढैरज्ञानप्रभवं महत् ।
अवाप्यते नरैर्दुःखं शिश्नोदरपरायणैः ॥
verses.rom:
evam pashusamairmudhairajnanaprabhavam mahat |
avapyate narairduhkham shishnodaraparayanaih ||

verses.sa:
अज्ञानं तामसो भावः कार्यारंभप्रवृत्तयः ।
अज्ञानिनां प्रवर्त्तंते कर्मलोपास्ततो द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
ajnanam tamaso bhavah karyarambhapravrittayah |
ajnaninam pravarttamte karmalopastato dvija ||

verses.sa:
नरकं कर्मणां लोपात्फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः ।
तस्मादज्ञानिनां दुःखमिह चामुत्र चोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
narakam karmanam lopatphalamahurmanishinah |
tasmadajnaninam duhkhamiha chamutra chottamam ||

verses.sa:
जराजर्जरदेहश्च शिथिलावयवः पुमान् ।
विचलच्छीर्णदशनो वलिस्नायुशिरावृतः ॥
verses.rom:
jarajarjaradehashcha shithilavayavah puman |
vichalachchhirnadashano valisnayushiravritah ||

verses.sa:
दूरप्रनष्टनयनो व्योमांतर्गततारकः ।
नासाविवरनिर्यातलोमपुंजश्चलद्वपुः ॥
verses.rom:
durapranashtanayano vyomamtargatatarakah |
nasavivaraniryatalomapumjashchaladvapuh ||

verses.sa:
प्रकटीभूतसर्वास्थिर्नतपृष्ठास्थिसंहतिः ।
उत्सन्नजठराग्नित्वादल्पाहारोऽल्पचेष्टितः ॥
verses.rom:
prakatibhutasarvasthirnataprishthasthisamhatih |
utsannajatharagnitvadalpaharo'lpacheshtitah ||

verses.sa:
कृच्छ्राच्चंक्रमणोत्थानशयनासनचेष्टितः ।
मंदीभवच्छ्रोत्रनेत्रस्स्रवल्लालाविलाननः ॥
verses.rom:
krichchhrachchamkramanotthanashayanasanacheshtitah |
mamdibhavachchhrotranetrassravallalavilananah ||

verses.sa:
अनायत्तैस्समस्तैश्च करणेर्मरणोन्मुखः ।
तत्क्षणेप्यनुभूतानामस्मर्ताऽखिलवस्तुनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
anayattaissamastaishcha karanermaranonmukhah |
tatkshanepyanubhutanamasmarta'khilavastunam ||

verses.sa:
सकृदुच्चारिते वाक्ये समुद्भूतमहाश्रमः ।
श्वासकाशसमुद्भूतमहायासप्रजागरः ॥
verses.rom:
sakriduchcharite vakye samudbhutamahashramah |
shvasakashasamudbhutamahayasaprajagarah ||

verses.sa:
अन्येनोत्थाप्यतेऽन्येन तथा संवेश्यते जरी ।
भृत्यात्मपुत्रदाराणामवमानास्पदी कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
anyenotthapyate'nyena tatha samveshyate jari |
bhrityatmaputradaranamavamanaspadi kritah ||

verses.sa:
प्रक्षीणाखिलशौचश्च विहाराहारसस्पृहः ।
हास्यः परिजनस्यापि निर्विण्णाश्षोबांधवः ॥
verses.rom:
prakshinakhilashauchashcha viharaharasasprihah |
hasyah parijanasyapi nirvinnashshobamdhavah ||

verses.sa:
अनुभूतमिवान्यस्मिञ्जन्मन्यात्मविचेष्टितम् ।
संस्मरन्यौवने दीर्घं निश्वसत्यभितापितः ॥
verses.rom:
anubhutamivanyasminjanmanyatmavicheshtitam |
samsmaranyauvane dirgham nishvasatyabhitapitah ||

verses.sa:
एवमादीनि दुःखानि जरायामनुभूय वै ।
मरणे यानि दुःखानि प्राप्नोति शृणुतान्यपि ॥
verses.rom:
evamadini duhkhani jarayamanubhuya vai |
marane yani duhkhani prapnoti shrinutanyapi ||

verses.sa:
श्लथद्ग्रीवांघ्रिहस्तोऽथ व्याप्तो वेपथुना भृशम् ।
मुहुर्ग्लानिः परवशो मुहुर्ज्ञानलवान्वितः ॥
verses.rom:
shlathadgrivamghrihasto'tha vyapto vepathuna bhrisham |
muhurglanih paravasho muhurjnanalavanvitah ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यधान्यतनय भार्याभृत्यगृहादिषु ।
एते कथं भविष्यंतीत्यतीव ममताकुलः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyadhanyatanaya bharyabhrityagrihadishu |
ete katham bhavishyamtityativa mamatakulah ||

verses.sa:
मर्मभिद्भिर्महारोगैः क्रकचैरिव दारुणैः ।
शरैरिवांतकस्योग्रैश्छिद्यमानासुबंधनः ॥
verses.rom:
marmabhidbhirmaharogaih krakachairiva darunaih |
sharairivamtakasyograishchhidyamanasubamdhanah ||

verses.sa:
परिवर्त्तितताराक्षो हस्तपादं मुहुः क्षिपन् ।
संशुष्यमाणताल्वोष्ठपुटो घुरघुरायते ॥
verses.rom:
parivarttitataraksho hastapadam muhuh kshipan |
samshushyamanatalvoshthaputo ghuraghurayate ||

verses.sa:
निरुद्धकंठो दोषौघैरुदानश्वासपीडितः ।
तापेन महता व्याप्तस्तृषा चार्त्तस्तथा क्षुधा ॥
verses.rom:
niruddhakamtho doshaughairudanashvasapiditah |
tapena mahata vyaptastrisha charttastatha kshudha ||

verses.sa:
क्लेशादुत्क्रांतिमाप्नोति यमकिंकरपीडितः ।
ततश्च यातनादेहं क्लेश्नो प्रतिपद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
kleshadutkramtimapnoti yamakimkarapiditah |
tatashcha yatanadeham kleshno pratipadyate ||

verses.sa:
एतान्यन्यानि चोग्राणि दुःखानि मरणे नृणाम् ।
शृणुष्व नरके यानि प्राप्यंते पुरुषैर्मृतैः ॥
verses.rom:
etanyanyani chograni duhkhani marane nrinam |
shrinushva narake yani prapyamte purushairmritaih ||

verses.sa:
याम्यकिंकरपाशादिग्रहणं दंडताडनम् ।
यमस्य दर्शनं चोग्रमुग्रमार्गविलोकनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamyakimkarapashadigrahanam damdatadanam |
yamasya darshanam chogramugramargavilokanam ||

verses.sa:
करंभवालुकावह्नियंत्रशस्त्रासिभीषणे ।
प्रत्येकं नरकेयाश्च यातना द्विज दुःसहाः ॥
verses.rom:
karambhavalukavahniyamtrashastrasibhishane |
pratyekam narakeyashcha yatana dvija duhsahah ||

verses.sa:
क्रकचैः पाट्यमानानां मूषायां चापि दह्यताम् ।
कुठारैः कृत्यमानानां भूमौ चापि निखन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
krakachaih patyamananam mushayam chapi dahyatam |
kutharaih krityamananam bhumau chapi nikhanyatam ||

verses.sa:
शूलेष्वारोप्यमाणानां व्याघ्रवक्त्रे प्रवेश्यताम् ।
गृध्रैस्संभक्ष्यमाणानां द्वीपिभिश्चोपभुज्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuleshvaropyamananam vyaghravaktre praveshyatam |
gridhraissambhakshyamananam dvipibhishchopabhujyatam ||

verses.sa:
क्वाथ्यतां तैलमध्ये च क्लिद्यतां क्षारकर्दमे ।
उच्चान्निपात्यमानानां क्षिप्यतां क्षेपयंत्रकैः ॥
verses.rom:
kvathyatam tailamadhye cha klidyatam ksharakardame |
uchchannipatyamananam kshipyatam kshepayamtrakaih ||

verses.sa:
नरके यानि दुःखानि पापहेतूद्भवानि वै ।
प्राप्यंते नारकैर्विप्र तेषां संख्या न विद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
narake yani duhkhani papahetudbhavani vai |
prapyamte narakairvipra tesham samkhya na vidyate ||

verses.sa:
न केवलं द्विजश्रेष्ठ नरके दुःखपद्धतिः ।
स्वर्गेपि पातभीतस्य क्षयिष्णोर्नास्ति निर्वृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
na kevalam dvijashreshtha narake duhkhapaddhatih |
svargepi patabhitasya kshayishnornasti nirvritih ||

verses.sa:
पुनश्च गर्भे भवति जायते च पुनःपुनः ।
गर्भे विलीयते भूयो जायमानोऽस्तमेति वै ॥
verses.rom:
punashcha garbhe bhavati jayate cha punahpunah |
garbhe viliyate bhuyo jayamano'stameti vai ||

verses.sa:
जातमात्रश्च म्रियते बालभावेऽथ यौवने ।
मध्यमं वा वयः प्राप्य वार्द्धके वाथ वा मृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
jatamatrashcha mriyate balabhave'tha yauvane |
madhyamam va vayah prapya varddhake vatha va mritih ||

verses.sa:
यावज्जीवति तावच्च दुःखैर्नानाविधैः प्लुतः ।
तं तु कारणपक्ष्मौघैरास्ते कार्पासबीजवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yavajjivati tavachcha duhkhairnanavidhaih plutah |
tam tu karanapakshmaughairaste karpasabijavat ||

verses.sa:
द्र व्यनाशो! तथोत्पत्तौ पालने च सदा नृणाम् ।
भवंत्यनेकदुःखानि तथैवेष्टविपत्तिषु ॥
verses.rom:
dra vyanasho! tathotpattau palane cha sada nrinam |
bhavamtyanekaduhkhani tathaiveshtavipattishu ||

verses.sa:
यद्यत्प्रीतिकरं पुंसां वस्तु मैत्रेय जायते ।
तदेव दुःखवृक्षस्य बीजत्वमुपगच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
yadyatpritikaram pumsam vastu maitreya jayate |
tadeva duhkhavrikshasya bijatvamupagachchhati ||

verses.sa:
कलत्रपुत्रमित्रार्थगृहक्षेत्रधनादिकैः ।
क्रियते न तथा भूरि सुखं पुंसां यथा सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
kalatraputramitrarthagrihakshetradhanadikaih |
kriyate na tatha bhuri sukham pumsam yatha sukham ||

verses.sa:
इति संसारदुःखार्कतापतापितचेतसाम् ।
विमुक्तिपादपच्छायामृते कुत्र सुखं नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
iti samsaraduhkharkatapatapitachetasam |
vimuktipadapachchhayamrite kutra sukham nrinam ||

verses.sa:
तदस्य त्रिविधस्याऽपि दुःखजातस्य वै मम ।
गर्भजन्मजराद्येषु स्थानेषु प्रभविष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
tadasya trividhasya'pi duhkhajatasya vai mama |
garbhajanmajaradyeshu sthaneshu prabhavishyatah ||

verses.sa:
निरस्तातिशयाह्लादसुखभावैकलक्षणा ।
भेषजं भगवत्प्राप्तिरेकांतात्यंतिकी मता ॥
verses.rom:
nirastatishayahladasukhabhavaikalakshana |
bheshajam bhagavatpraptirekamtatyamtiki mata ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्तत्प्राप्तये यत्नः कर्त्तव्यः पंडितैर्नरैः ।
तत्प्राप्तिहेतुर्ज्ञानं च कर्म चोक्तं महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
tasmattatpraptaye yatnah karttavyah pamditairnaraih |
tatpraptiheturjnanam cha karma choktam mahamune ||

verses.sa:
आगमोत्थं विवेकाच्च द्विधा ज्ञानं तदुच्यते ।
शब्दब्रह्मागममयं परं ब्रह्म विवेकजम् ॥
verses.rom:
agamottham vivekachcha dvidha jnanam taduchyate |
shabdabrahmagamamayam param brahma vivekajam ||

verses.sa:
अंधं तम इवाज्ञानं दीपवच्चेंद्रियोद्भवम् ।
यथा सूर्यस्तथा ज्ञानं यद्विप्रर्षे विवेकजम् ॥
verses.rom:
amdham tama ivajnanam dipavachchemdriyodbhavam |
yatha suryastatha jnanam yadviprarshe vivekajam ||

verses.sa:
मनुरप्याह वेदार्थं स्मृत्वा यन्मुनिसत्तम ।
तदेतच्छ्रूयतामत्र संबंधे गदतो मम ॥
verses.rom:
manurapyaha vedartham smritva yanmunisattama |
tadetachchhruyatamatra sambamdhe gadato mama ||

verses.sa:
द्वे ब्रह्मणी वेदितव्ये शब्दब्रह्म परं च यत् ।
शब्दब्रह्मणि निष्णातः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
dve brahmani veditavye shabdabrahma param cha yat |
shabdabrahmani nishnatah param brahmadhigachchhati ||

verses.sa:
द्वे वै विद्ये वेदितव्ये इति चाथर्वणी श्रुतिः ।
परया त्वक्षरप्राप्तिरृग्वेदादिमयापरा ॥
verses.rom:
dve vai vidye veditavye iti chatharvani shrutih |
paraya tvaksharapraptirrigvedadimayapara ||

verses.sa:
यत्तदव्यक्तमजरमचिंत्यमजमव्ययम् ।
अनिर्द्देश्यमरूपं च पाणिपादाद्यसंयुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yattadavyaktamajaramachimtyamajamavyayam |
anirddeshyamarupam cha panipadadyasamyutam ||

verses.sa:
विभु सर्वगतं नित्यं भूतयोनिरकारणम् ।
व्याप्य प्याप्तं यतः सर्वं यद्वै पश्यंति सूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
vibhu sarvagatam nityam bhutayonirakaranam |
vyapya pyaptam yatah sarvam yadvai pashyamti surayah ||

verses.sa:
तद्ब्रह्म तत्परं धाम तद्ध्येयं मोक्षकांक्षिभिः ।
श्रुतिवाक्योदितं सूक्ष्मं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadbrahma tatparam dhama taddhyeyam mokshakamkshibhih |
shrutivakyoditam sukshmam tadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
तदेव भगवद्वाच्यं स्वरूपं परमात्मनः ।
वाचको भगवच्छब्दस्तस्याद्यस्याक्षयात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tadeva bhagavadvachyam svarupam paramatmanah |
vachako bhagavachchhabdastasyadyasyakshayatmanah ||

verses.sa:
एवं निगदितार्थस्य तत्तत्त्वं तस्य तत्त्वतः ।
ज्ञायते येन तज्ज्ञानं परमन्यत्त्रयीमयम् ॥
verses.rom:
evam nigaditarthasya tattattvam tasya tattvatah |
jnayate yena tajjnanam paramanyattrayimayam ||

verses.sa:
अशब्दगोचरस्यापि तस्य वै ब्रह्मणो द्विज ।
पूजायां भगवच्छब्दः क्रियते ह्युपचारतः ॥
verses.rom:
ashabdagocharasyapi tasya vai brahmano dvija |
pujayam bhagavachchhabdah kriyate hyupacharatah ||

verses.sa:
शुद्धे महाविभूत्याख्ये परे ब्रह्मणि शब्दिते ।
मैत्रेय भगवच्छब्दस्सर्वकारणकारणे ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhe mahavibhutyakhye pare brahmani shabdite |
maitreya bhagavachchhabdassarvakaranakarane ||

verses.sa:
संभर्त्तेति तथा भर्त्ता भकारोर्थद्वयान्वितः ।
